categories.description: Overseeing the internal review process.
categories.name: Manage internal reviews

categories.description: Obtaining required company-internal authorizations.
categories.name: Manage internal approvals

categories.description: Delivering the proposal to the potential client.
categories.name: Submit/present bid/proposal/quote to customer

categories.description: Amending bids, proposals or quotes with more accurate time, cost or delivery estimates.
categories.name: Revise bid/proposal/quote

categories.description: Handling proposals depending on whether they were accepted or rejected.
categories.name: Manage notification outcome

categories.description: Taking, receiving, processing, and acknowledging new customer orders or amendments to outstanding customer orders. Monitoring status from order receipt to customer delivery/customer invoicing.
categories.name: 管理销售订单

categories.description: Receiving and confirming orders from customers. Verify that no extra expenses have to be disbursed on part of the organization for labor or inventory when processing the order.
categories.name: Accept and validate sales orders

categories.description: Collecting and maintaining all account information. Collect information about the purchase, servicing, return, and/or commitment of any products/services on part of the organization to its customers. Bring together information from various organizational divisions, and update periodically.
categories.name: Collect and maintain account information

categories.description: Managing essential information of customer accounts.
categories.name: Administer key account details

categories.description: Obtaining detailed information about customers.
categories.name: Retrieve full customer details

categories.description: Altering information about involved parties.
categories.name: Modify involved party details

categories.description: Documenting address information.
categories.name: Record address details

categories.description: Documenting contact information.
categories.name: Record contact details

categories.name_en: Record key customer communication profile details
categories.description: Providing information about important business rules regarding communicating with customers.
categories.name: Record key customer communication profile details

categories.description: Revising information about involved parties.
categories.name: Review involved party information

categories.description: Dismissing information about involved parties.
categories.name: Terminate involved party information

categories.description: Ascertaining the volume or scale of products/services to provide to customers to fulfill sales orders. Check the finished products stored in warehouses, the production capacity, and (in the case of services) the processing speed, as well as work force availability.
categories.name: Determine availability

categories.description: Devising a blueprint for order fulfillment. Create a schematic flow encompassing all activities to deliver orders to the customers. Outline a procedure for satisfying these orders by answering questions about what needs to happen in sequence to realize an order.
categories.name: Determine fulfillment process

categories.description: Processing any unfulfilled orders, and updating the status of any orders that have been accepted and are being attended to. Deliver on any purchase orders that remain unserviced due to temporary unavailability of the product/service. Manage any updates to the sales orders. Revise their status in the order system.
categories.name: Process back orders and updates

categories.name_en: Handle sales order inquiries including post-order fulfillment transactions
categories.description: Attending to any queries received from the customers, even after a sales order has been serviced. Deploy ad hoc personnel for managing these enquiries.
categories.name: Handle sales order inquiries including post-order fulfillment transactions

categories.description: Providing visibility into the status and progress of products associated with customer orders to support order fulfillment, customer communication, and issue resolution.
categories.name: Provide product tracking

categories.description: Managing the organization's partners and alliances, with the objective of maximizing revenue. Train partners regarding the organization's portfolio of products/services. Craft sales forecasts. Examine their performance. Manage all data held by the organization on these partners.
categories.name_zh: 管理销售合作伙伴与联盟
categories.name: 管理销售合作伙伴与联盟

categories.name_en: Provide sales and product/service training to sales partners/alliances
categories.description: Imparting guidance and instruction to sales partners/alliances concerning products/services. Distribute literature about the organization's products/services. Conduct workshops. Disseminate useful media content to engage and enlighten partners. Create communities through group engagements.
categories.name: Provide sales and product/service training to sales partners/alliances

categories.description: Provide training and certification to develop strategies for marketing-driven sales.
categories.name: Provide certification enablement training

categories.description: Reviewing, processing and issuing certifications and accrediting skills and competencies.
categories.name: Manage certifications and skills

categories.description: Backing sales partners and strategic alliances.
categories.name: Provide support to partners/alliances

categories.name_en: Provide marketing materials to sales partners/alliances
categories.description: Distributing marketing materials and sales brochures to entities that the company partners with.
categories.name: Provide marketing materials to sales partners/alliances

categories.description: Examining the performance of its partners/alliances in selling its products/services. Use metrics such as growth in revenue generated, conversion rate, and total outreach to customers for assessing the performance results.
categories.name: Evaluate partner/alliance results

categories.description: Managing the repository of data relating to the organization's partners/alliances over time. Store, maintain, access, revise, and use all data on partners/alliances. Manage data. Ensure its security. Determine legitimate use cases that are beneficial to the organization.
categories.name: Manage sales partner/alliance master data

categories.description: Execution of sales at physical / brick and mortar locations.
categories.name: 实体门店销售

categories.description: Execution of sales within field/remote locations.  This could be any location that is not part of a headquarters location.
categories.name: 现场销售

categories.description: Execution of sales in an online environment.
categories.name: 数字化销售

categories.name_en: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
categories.description: Performing supply chain activities include planning supply chain, procuring materials and services, and managing logistics.
categories.name_zh: 面向实物产品的供应链管理
categories.name: 面向实物产品的供应链管理

categories.name_en: Plan for and align supply chain resources
categories.description: Creating strategies for production and materials. Handle the demand for the products of the organization. Develop plans for handling materials. Develop and administer the schedule for master production. Plan for distribution requirements and its constraints by reviewing and assessing distribution policies and performance and by establishing quality standards and procedures.
categories.name_zh: 规划并匹配供应链资源
categories.name: 规划并匹配供应链资源

categories.description: Creating strategies for production processes, as well as the process of managing materials. Define production and supply constraints. Design a blueprint of the workplace. Establish rules and regulations regarding the employees, outsourcing of services, and the expenditure to be incurred on the manufacturing capital.
categories.name: 制定生产与物料战略

categories.description: Creating quantifiable strategic objectives for each manufacturing segment in conjunction with sales projections.
categories.name: Define manufacturing goals

categories.description: Setting up internal rules and regulations regarding the employees and the materials.
categories.name: Define labor and materials policies

categories.description: Creating rules and regulations regarding contracting out of a business process to another party in order to reduce costs.
categories.name: Define outsourcing policies

categories.description: Designing rules and regulations pertaining to the expenditure incurred in acquiring or upgrading the existing stock of manufacturing capital.
categories.name: Define capital expense policies

categories.description: Outlining the manufacturing and processing capacities of the organization. Delineate the capabilities required for optimizing output with available resources. Analyze capabilities possessed by the organization concerning the raw materials required and the process necessitated for producing finished products.
categories.name: Define capacities

categories.name_en: Define production network and supply constraints
categories.description: Defining limitations in the ability of the organization's supply chain to deliver a new stock, and creating a network of production stakeholders. Frame and manage relationships within the flow of manufacturing and processing operations. Identify probable supply issues.
categories.name: Define production network and supply constraints

categories.description: Outlining the scheme of processing inventory into finished products/services. This includes the use of raw materials, machinery, skill sets, and knowledge to create new offerings.
categories.name: Define production process

categories.description: Establishing or prescribing methods to be followed routinely for the performance of designated operations or in designated situations. This may include step-by-step instructions to help workers carry out complex routine operations. The goal is to improve efficiency, quality, and uniformity of performance, while reducing miscommunication, failure, or rework.
categories.name: Define standard operating procedures

categories.name_en: Define production workplace layout and infrastructure
categories.description: Determining the floor plans for the processing facility that is meant for delivering finished products/services. Identify the totality of infrastructure needed for using this space in the manufacturing process, including machinery, factory floors, offices, and furniture.
categories.name: Define production workplace layout and infrastructure

categories.description: Forecasting demand for products using secondary research and customer feedback. Refine these forecasts. Inspect the approach used in creating forecasts, and determine its accuracy.
categories.name: 管理产品需求

categories.description: Identify the bedrock levels of market demand anticipated for the organization's products/services. Estimate future demand for product and services using historical data, analysis of the market environment and any externalities, etc. to create ex ante approximations. This includes operation planning.
categories.name: Develop baseline demand forecasts

categories.description: Working closely with the organization's customers to understand their drives and behavior, with the objective of estimating future demand. Reach out to customers through various means to understand their behavior patterns, usage elasticity, and degree of variability--and ultimately determine demand for each offering.
categories.name: Collaborate demand with customers

categories.description: Arriving at a consensus over the forecasted levels of demand for products/services. Consensus is achieved by juxtaposing decisions developed in the baseline forecast with those reached at by collaborating with customers. Enlist senior-level decision makers of the sales and marketing functions.
categories.name: Develop demand consensus forecast

categories.description: Identify the volume of products/services that may be committed for delivery to fulfill sales. Figure out the amount of stock available. Forecast its volumes.
categories.name: Determine available to promise

categories.name_en: Monitor activity against demand forecast and revise forecast
categories.description: Picking out any activity that deviates from the forecast, and adjusting it. Closely track and study the levels of demand as they emerge. Refine the consensus forecast as needed.
categories.name: Monitor activity against demand forecast and revise forecast

categories.name_en: Evaluate and revise demand forecasting approach
categories.description: Examining the methodology used to estimate future demand. Refine it in light of current market realities and demand.
categories.name: Evaluate and revise demand forecasting approach

categories.description: Calculating and inspecting the accuracy of demand forecasts. Use metrics to check the reliability of the forecasts created.
categories.name: Measure demand forecast accuracy

categories.description: Developing a scheme that allows for advance planning for the availability of raw materials and spares. Start with an unconstrained plan, and refine based on supply chain realities by identifying critical materials required for production, checking material specifications, and collaborating with all vendors over the supply.
categories.name: 创建物料计划

categories.description: Developing a plan for raw materials and other inventory items in order to meet market demand. Ensure the availability of all inventory items such as raw materials and spares. Create a blueprint in line with Define labor and materials policies [10230].
categories.name: Create unconstrained plan

categories.name_en: Collaborate with supplier and contract manufacturers
categories.description: Collaborating with vendors and contractual manufacturers with the objective of ensuring a continual supply of raw materials and spares. Leverage long-term connections/relationships with various suppliers, and cultivate new ones. Track the activities of all vendors. Receive regular updates to prepare for any fluctuations in supply.
categories.name: Collaborate with supplier and contract manufacturers

categories.name_en: Identify critical materials and supplier capacity
categories.description: Identifying principal materials needed for the manufacturing process and the levels of supply that may be ensured for them. Determine the essential and crucial inventory items required for the smooth functioning of all manufacturing processes. Estimate the average, peak, and baseline capacities of various vendors and suppliers. Establish the capability of individual suppliers from the market and the vendors.
categories.name: Identify critical materials and supplier capacity

categories.description: Observing and surveying all inventory items in order to check for the veracity of their specifications. Monitor various attributes and characteristics for respective inventory items such as density, volume, and size, as well as contextualized specifications particular to the respective materials.
categories.name: Monitor material specifications

categories.description: Generating a bounded plan that takes stock of the actual supply chain scenario. Take stock of all information collected while creating an inventory supply plan.
categories.name: Generate constrained plan

categories.description: Defining an equitable volume for the production of products/services that adheres to an equilibrium value, and creating a scheme of control for processing items. Create schematics for systematically planning, coordinating, and directing the manufacturing activities in line with the production balance determined.
categories.name: Define production balance and control

categories.name_en: Create and manage master production schedule
categories.description: Taking care of the master production plan. The master production includes creation and implementation of the site-level production plan, as well as management of the inventory that is currently in the production process.
categories.name_zh: 创建和管理主生产计划
categories.name: 创建和管理主生产计划

categories.name_en: Model production network to enable simulation and optimization
categories.description: Create representative logical system that provides the framework to attain strategic objectives based on resources, product volumes, and processes. Provides the general sequential flow and capacity requirement relationships among raw materials, parts, resources, finished products, and product families.
categories.name: Model production network to enable simulation and optimization

categories.description: Creating  the plan for internal activities such as production, inventory, and staffing. Include forecasted quantity of items to produce based on inputs from sales planning, demand planning/forecasting, and supply chain partners.
categories.name: Create master production schedule

categories.description: Supervising and overseeing the plan for internal activities such as production, inventory, and staffing. Set the quantity of items to produce each week of a short-range planning horizon.
categories.name: Maintain master production schedule

categories.description: Maintaining master data of finished products and inventory. Identify the requirements of finished products at the destination, as well as partner requirements. Calculate the consolidation at source. Manage replenishment planning. Create and administer a dispatch plan. Calculate load plans for destinations and partners. Manage the cost of supplying these products. Ensure effective utilization of capacity.
categories.name: 规划配送需求

categories.description: Maintaining and preserving the master data plan for distribution requirements. Create a systematic collection of facts and figures regarding the distribution of the inventories. Maintain policies, processes, and tools covering the distribution function.
categories.name: Maintain master data

categories.name_en: Determine finished goods inventory requirements at destination
categories.description: Interact with the concerned person at the destination to validate the requirements and to avoid any miscommunication of information.
categories.name: Determine finished goods inventory requirements at destination

categories.description: Evaluate constraints, needs, parameters, and conditions for physical storage and retrieval of components or products for future use or shipment in a storage facility within a certain timeframe.
categories.name: Determine product storage facility requirements

categories.description: Interact with the concerned authority at the destination to reach a specific figure that correctly represents requirements.
categories.name: Calculate requirements at destination

categories.description: Determining the aggregate volume of products/services consolidated at the source. Calculate the number of finished products that are ready to be delivered to the customers, particularly at one date.
categories.name: Calculate consolidation at source

categories.description: Administering the plan for collaborative replenishment of goods. Replenish inventory by creating a plan in case of faulty production.
categories.name: Manage collaborative replenishment planning

categories.name_en: Calculate and optimize destination dispatch plan
categories.description: Estimating the timing and duration of the delivery of the inventory from the source to the destination. Plan the logistic details of all the distribution routes and activities.
categories.name: Calculate and optimize destination dispatch plan

categories.description: Accomplishing the dispatch plan. Strictly follow the schedule, and adjust for deviations. Coordinate with the concerned authorities at various destinations.
categories.name: Manage dispatch plan attainment

categories.name_en: Calculate and optimize destination load plans
categories.description: Evaluating the plans for delivering loads to destinations. Create a systematic plan that specifies the load plans for every single destination.
categories.name: Calculate and optimize destination load plans

categories.description: Administering the load plan for partners. Manage the delivery, and dispatch from the source to the partners.
categories.name: Manage partner load plan

categories.description: Managing all expenses to provide products/services in the market. Estimate the overall cost of supplying of products/inventory, including the cost distributing it through various partners and channels. Consider the cost of all the logistical processes that occur from the moment a product is ready to be dispatched to the time it reaches the destination.
categories.name: Manage cost of supply

categories.description: Determining the capacity utilization of the organization's production process. Realize the extent to which an enterprise uses its installed productive capacity (i.e., the relationship between output and the potential output if capacity was fully used).
categories.name: Manage capacity utilization

categories.description: Instituting the constraints for planning of distribution process. Create a plan that specifies every element in the distribution process from the blueprint of the distribution centers to how and when the inventory would reach the distribution centers.
categories.name_zh: 建立配送计划约束条件
categories.name: 建立配送计划约束条件

categories.description: Instituting the constraints for creating a layout for distribution center. Consider factors such as the number of customers, demand forecasting, product groups, condition of product conservation, warehousing, and transportation management.
categories.name: Establish distribution center layout constraints

categories.description: Determining any problems that might be faced while managing inventory. Identify problems and possible issues in managing the warehousing of the raw materials, spares, and other items of inventory. Take stock of inventory needs, and determine the exact quantity of the inventory needed in the near future.
categories.name: Establish inventory management constraints

categories.description: Identifying any potential constraints while deciding on the dispatch and delivery plan from the source to the various distribution centers. Decide how the inventory will be transported , which and how many transportation means to use, what route to take, etc.
categories.name: Establish transportation management constraints

categories.description: Determining potential constraints for physical storage and retrieval of components or products in a storage facility within a certain timeframe. Consider factors such as the building shape, height, capacity, door locations, lift equipment, automation, etc.
categories.name: Establish storage management constraints

categories.description: Revisiting and refurbishing the policies for planning the distribution process. Asses the distribution strategies, including how the products are to be made available and sent to different distributors. Set guidelines regarding relationships between the sources and the distribution centers.
categories.name: 评审配送计划政策

categories.description: Evaluating the system that defines how the products/inventory would reach from the source (i.e., manufacturer) to the destination (i.e., retailer/distributer).
categories.name: Review distribution network

categories.description: Establishing relationships with transportation/distribution sources in order to ensure an effective distribution network and strategy. Screen and evaluate various sources available to pick out the best among them.
categories.name: Establish sourcing relationships

categories.description: Creating strategic guidelines on the availability of the products at all the distribution centers. Create a dynamic network to ensure availability at all times, even in cases of defaults.
categories.name: Establish dynamic deployment policies

categories.description: Developing standards and procedures for maintaining the quality of products/services. Establish desired quality targets. Create standardized procedures for the quality. Ensure quality specifications are effectively communicated.
categories.name: 制定质量标准与程序

categories.description: Defining specific qualitative and quantitative target figures.
categories.name: Establish quality targets

categories.description: Creating standard procedures for testing the quality of products/services. Describe the steps of key processes to help ensure consistent and quality output. Define the routine instructions for performing the quality testing activity.
categories.name: Develop standard testing procedures

categories.description: Communicating the desired quality specifications to the manufacturing units, as well as the distribution centers, to avoid any misunderstanding or misinterpretation.
categories.name: Communicate quality specifications

categories.description: Creating a plan for procuring materials and services. Develop strategies for sourcing materials and services. Choose the most appropriate suppliers, and develop contracts with them. Order the materials and services as per the requirements. Manage relationships with suppliers.
categories.name: 采购物料与服务

categories.description: Creating strategies for procuring materials and services from various sources, and for managing and evaluating categories. Establish a procurement process that describes the approach for obtaining products and purchasing activities. Evaluate the sources. Create sourcing relationships in order to continuously improve. Re-evaluate purchasing activities.
categories.change_details: +21616, RENAME, WAS:Provide sourcing governance and perform category management
categories.name: 提供寻源治理

categories.description: Creating a plan for procuring materials and services. Plan what to buy, when, and from what sources. Include project requirements, the procurement team, the justification for the procurement, a timeline of events, and an explanation of the supplier selection process. Outline specific actions to start and complete purchases in order to adhere to best practices.
categories.name: Develop procurement plan

categories.description: Defining the purchasing requirements for materials and services. Specify the exact inventory required for the production process. Create a specific quotation for all the sources in order to avoid any duplication or overlap.
categories.name: Clarify purchasing requirements

categories.description: Developing a strategy to deal with issues projected to arise during implementation of the inventory plan. Identify how to react to issues that arise and require changes to the inventory plan, such as a vendor failing to deliver materials on time. Collaborate with production and suppliers to prepare solutions to projected problems.
categories.name: Establish materials management contingency plans

categories.description: Synchronizing the requirements of materials and services and the capacity of suppliers for providing these materials and services. Revamp the procurement needs of the company in consideration of the capabilities of the suppliers.
categories.name: Match needs to supply capabilities

categories.description: Evaluating the spend profile of the organization. Collect, cleanse, classify, and analyze the procurement data with the purpose of reducing procurement costs, improving efficiency, and monitoring compliance.
categories.name: Analyze organization’s spend profile

categories.name_en: Seek opportunities to improve efficiency and value
categories.description: Seeking the most efficient sourcing and procurement opportunities.
categories.name: Seek opportunities to improve efficiency and value

categories.name_en: Collaborate with suppliers to align with long term business goals
categories.description: Collaborating with the suppliers of materials and services in order to determine new opportunities for sourcing, share market insights, manage risk, identify and align supplier capabilities with long-term business goals.
categories.name: Collaborate with suppliers to align with long term business goals

categories.name_en: Collaborate with suppliers to identify sourcing opportunities
categories.description: Collaborating with the suppliers of materials and services in order to determine new opportunities for sourcing.
categories.name: Collaborate with suppliers to identify sourcing opportunities

categories.description: Defining sourcing strategies and plans for categories of materials or services to optimize cost, supply continuity, value, and alignment with organizational requirements and market conditions.
categories.name: 制定品类计划

categories.description: Analyzing the position and performance of sourcing categories or products based on spend, supplier dynamics, market conditions, and value contribution to inform category planning decisions.
categories.name: Analyze category/product positioning and performance

categories.name_en: Forecast demand for each category by market
categories.description: Forecasting demand for sourcing categories across relevant markets or consumption channels to support planning, supplier strategy, and capacity alignment.
categories.name: Forecast demand for each category by market

categories.name_en: Assign revenue and margin targets to each category
categories.description: Establishing revenue, cost, and margin targets for sourcing categories to guide category strategy, sourcing decisions, and performance evaluation.
categories.name: Assign revenue and margin targets to each category

categories.description: Evaluating supplier options to select the most effective and efficient suppliers. Validate selected suppliers. Establish and manage supplier contracts.
categories.name_zh: 选择供应商并开发/维护合同
categories.name: 选择供应商并开发/维护合同

categories.description: Evaluating the pros and cons of various suppliers. Choose the most appropriate and cost-effective suppliers on the basis of their material quality, delivery schedules, and costs.
categories.name: Select suppliers

categories.description: Validating the supply sources, and provide certification as an official supplier.
categories.name: Certify and validate suppliers

categories.description: Legally binding suppliers with the company. Negotiate contracts individually with all the suppliers that include the promised material delivery, the delivery dates and duration, etc.
categories.name: Negotiate and establish contracts

categories.description: Keeping contracts up-to-date with routine evaluation. Maintain order and discipline with the contracts in order to avoid any loss of information and mishaps.
categories.name: Manage contracts

categories.description: Creating and approving requisitions and distributing purchase orders accordingly. Hasten the procurement process to satisfy internal needs.
categories.name: 订购物料与服务

categories.description: Handling operations related to processing/reviewing the requisitions. Establish and maintain procedures for the initiation, authorization, and processing of purchase requirements to procure products/services.
categories.name: Process/Review requisitions

categories.description: Approving requisitions for materials and services. Examine distributor-specific requests, and validate them individually.
categories.name: Approve requisitions

categories.description: Requesting quotes from suppliers. Use a request for quotation (RFQ) to invite suppliers into a bidding process for specific products/services.
categories.name: Solicit supplier quotes

categories.description: Creating and placing the orders for purchasing materials and services from suppliers. Analyze vendor quotes. Choose the most cost-effective vendors. Create vendor-specific orders. Distribute them in order to initiate the purchasing process.
categories.name: Create/Distribute purchase orders

categories.description: Accelerating the purchase orders in order to fulfill the internal needs (for raw materials) depicted through inquiries.
categories.name: Expedite orders and satisfy inquiries

categories.description: Verify that purchase orders are filled as expected: verify that items and quantities are delivered as expected, based on purchase order details and goods receipts.
categories.name: Reconcile purchase orders

categories.description: Identifying and resolving any exceptions. Address the internal needs/inquiries for materials that cannot be procured immediately. Research inquiries that require the need of exceptional materials.
categories.name: Research/Resolve order exceptions

categories.description: Collecting and analyzing new information in order to track and rate suppliers and build relationships.
categories.name: 管理供应商

categories.description: Create and maintain vendor master files. Examining procurement and vendor performance. Report delivery timing and the quality of the materials procured through different vendors.  This data must align with vendor master file, see PCFID 10869.
categories.name: Monitor/Manage supplier information

categories.description: Assisting the production and inventory processes through the information and reports created. Use the information and metrics of the procurement and vendor performance to enhance or improve the production process.
categories.name: Prepare/Analyze procurement and supplier performance

categories.description: Support inventory and production processes by analyzing impact of procurement decisions and collaborating to constantly improve. (For example, perhaps minimum order requirements could be negotiated to be lower, to reduce excessive inventory and make production more flexible.)
categories.name: Support inventory and production processes

categories.description: Track the performance of the suppliers on product quality. Use this information to further improve sourcing and supplier performance.
categories.name: Monitor quality of product delivered

categories.description: Processing and delivering the finished goods manufactured by the organization. Schedule the production of products. Execute the product production activities. Perform tests to oversee and ensure quality of production. Maintain records of the production process. Track lots.
categories.name: 生产/装配/测试产品

categories.description: Scheduling the production of final products. Generate a detailed schedule plan. Create and release production orders and lots. Schedule the planned and unplanned maintenance orders.
categories.name: 排程生产

categories.description: Creating a representation of plant facilities to optimize material flow, resource utilization, and logistics for all levels of plant planning from global production facilities, through local plants, to specific lines and enabling the comparison of production�alternatives,.
categories.name: Model and simulate plant

categories.description: Initiating the line-level plan for production. Break down the production schedule into specific lines, specifying the various objectives the production schedule.
categories.name: Generate line level plan

categories.description: Broadening the line-level plan. Specify all the individual production processes, along with the timing and the duration to come up with a working schedule that tracks the whole process and any deviations that might occur.
categories.name: Generate detailed schedule

categories.name_en: Schedule production orders and create lots
categories.description: Creating a schedule to commence production of orders received, and creating lots to consolidate the processing. Plan when the production orders are to be initiated by commencing the operations for processing products/services. Specify which materials to produce, where to produce them, which operations will facilitate this, and on which date production is to start. Define the size of production lots, demarcating the durations of batch production.
categories.name: Schedule production orders and create lots

categories.description: Scheduling planned maintenance of the production equipment.
categories.name: Plan for preventive maintenance

categories.description: Scheduling requested maintenance in order to address breakdowns where repairs or corrective remedies are needed immediately. Create a scheme for undertaking unplanned maintenance work on equipment/machinery that has come to be in urgent need for it. Express turnaround to redress using specialized personnel.
categories.name: Request unplanned maintenance

categories.name_en: Release production orders and create lots
categories.description: Initiating the delivery of production orders, and creating lots. Communicate the order that specifies which material to produce, where to produce it, which operations to require, and on which date production takes place. Define how to settle the order costs. Create production lots, which is a particular production unit of an assembly that is planned and manufactured.
categories.name: Release production orders and create lots

categories.description: Manufacturing the product. Convert the raw materials to develop consumer-ready products. Manage the raw materials to implement the detailed production schedule. Reproduce defectives to establish and remediate cause. Ensure production optimization and benchmark performance.
categories.name: 生产/装配产品

categories.description: Administering the inventory of raw materials. Manage the total cost of all component parts in stock but not yet used. Manage the cost of the direct materials (i.e., materials incorporated into the final product) and indirect materials (i.e., materials not incorporated into the final product but consumed during the production process).
categories.name: Manage raw material inventory

categories.description: Creating and implementing the detailed line production schedule on the ground level.
categories.name: Execute detailed line schedule

categories.description: Recording and reporting any deviations or issues in the maintenance schedule, in the performance to the production management team, and for unplanned maintenance.
categories.name: Report maintenance issues

categories.description: Reproducing the items produced defectively. Assess the produced items by conducting quality and standardization tests in order to diagnose any discrepancies. Reproduce defective items.
categories.name: Rerun defective items

categories.description: Integrating different resources in the production process: material, personnel, equipment, robotics, etc. Includes automating and controlling the plant, performing advanced process control and real-time optimization. This activity also includes managing plant alarms and alerts.
categories.name: Monitor and optimize production process

categories.description: Creating and applying technology to monitor and control the production and delivery of products and services. Automation involves a broad range of technologies.
categories.name: Automate and control plant

categories.description: Including a broad range of techniques and technologies implemented within industrial process control systems that are routinely reviewed, audited, and improved, advanced process controls typically address particular performance or economic improvement opportunities. An advanced set of process control measures can be used to reduce variation and identify primary improvement options. Results of analysis are fed back into process design for incorporation into production.
categories.name: Perform advanced process control

categories.description: Helping organizations increase performance and efficiency, real-time optimization is a category of closed-loop process control that aims at optimizing process performance in real time for systems. It is normally built upon model-based optimization systems and is usually large scale. Real-time optimization automatically detects errors, and can modify and eliminate both random and non-random errors, as well as analyze and monitor all systems involved.
categories.name: Perform real-time optimization

categories.description: Applying human factors and instrumentation engineering and systems thinking to manage the design of an alarm or alert system to increase its usability. Typical challenges include having too many alarms in a plant, poorly designed alarms/alerts, improperly set alarm/alert points, unclear alarm/alert messages, etc. Poor alarm management is one of the leading causes of unplanned downtime.
categories.name: Manage plant alarms and alerts

categories.description: Analyzing and benchmarking the production process to judge its effectiveness and efficiency. Create production metrics to numerically calculate the performance of the production process.
categories.name: Assess production performance

categories.description: Executing tests to evaluate the quality of the products manufactured. Calibrate the test equipment. Conduct the actual tests. Record the results and outcomes of the quality test conducted.
categories.name: 执行质量测试

categories.description: Regulating the equipment used for performing quality tests. Assess correspondence between the quality testing equipment and the desired quality standards. Ensure the calibration standard is more accurate than the instrument being tested.
categories.name: Calibrate test equipment

categories.name_en: Perform testing using the standard testing procedure
categories.description: Performing testing using calibrated equipment and in consent with the standard testing procedure, including testing time.
categories.name: Perform testing using the standard testing procedure

categories.description: Selecting a set of elements from a product lot to draw conclusions or make inferences about the quality of the product lot from which the sample is drawn. Sampling is frequently used because gathering data on every product produced by a company is often impossible, impractical, or too costly to collect.
categories.name: Manage quality samples

categories.description: Documenting the results and outcomes of the quality tests. Track the performance of the production process. Record/Document it to evaluate the qualitative efficiency of the production process. Use electronic devices and software in order to ensure effectiveness in recording the results and outcomes of the test.
categories.name: Record test results

categories.description: Managing and monitoring the occurrences of problems with a process or product. It is important that nonconformance occurrences are tracked in a standardized way so the data can easily be reviewed to assess the impact of the problem. Ongoing analysis of trends in nonconformance gives an organization the ability to make process changes to reduce the incidence and cost of nonconformances.
categories.name: Track and analyze non-conformance trends

categories.description: Using a technique that helps people answer the question of why a problem occurred in the first place. It seeks to identify the origin of a problem using a specific set of steps, with associated tools, to find the primary cause of the problem to determine what happened, why, and how to reduce the likelihood that it will happen again.
categories.name: Perform root cause analysis

categories.name_en: Maintain production records and manage lot traceability
categories.description: Perpetuating the production records by systematically documenting and using it to ensure the effective management of lots. Determine the lot numbering system and its use. (The lot number enables tracking of the constituent parts, as well as labor and equipment records involved in the manufacturing of a product. It enables manufacturers and to perform quality control checks, calculate expiration dates, and issue corrections of their production output.)
categories.name_zh: 维护生产记录与批次可追溯性
categories.name: 维护生产记录与批次可追溯性

categories.description: Allotting an identification number to a particular quantity or lot of material manufactured. Assign lot numbers on the basis of specific production units, material similarity, etc. Place lot numbers on the outside of packaging.
categories.name: Determine lot numbering system

categories.description: Identifying the use of production lots. Define where, how, and when to use a specific production lot.
categories.name: Determine lot use

categories.description: Administering and overseeing all activities related to logistics and warehousing. Outline and establish a strategy for the logistics function. Plan and administer the flow of inbound materials. Administer the operational activities of warehousing and outbound transportation. Manage reverse logistics including returns and exchanges.
categories.name: 管理物流与仓储

categories.description: Outlining the strategy for managing logistics. Translate customer requirements logistic requirements. Create an efficient logistic network and outsourcing portions of logistics activities. Design a logistics strategy that optimizes transportation costs and schedule. Define key performance indicators.
categories.name: 提供物流治理

categories.name_en: Translate customer service requirements into logistics requirements
categories.description: Determining the requirements for managing the flow of things between the point of origin and the point of consumption by assessing the service requirements of the customers.
categories.name: Translate customer service requirements into logistics requirements

categories.description: Developing a network for logistical activities. Create a network of entities through which materials and information flow, encompassing all related activities associated with the flow of transformation of products.
categories.name: Design logistics network

categories.description: Conveying outsourcing needs within the organization, with the objective of sourcing the assistance required. Define the portion of logistical activities that can be transferred to outside suppliers. Assess third-party agencies to carefully select the most appropriate agencies for outsourcing. Convey these needs to management or the appropriate authority.
categories.name: Communicate outsourcing needs

categories.name_en: Develop and maintain delivery service policy
categories.description: Establishing rules and regulations, as well as the terms and conditions regarding the delivery of service by the company. Develop a delivery plan that specifies what, how, when, and in which way to deliver services to the customer.
categories.name: Develop and maintain delivery service policy

categories.description: Optimizing the schedule and costs of transportation services. Design a logistics strategy by strategically creating delivery routes and systems, which optimizes the overall transportation schedules and costs. Evaluate different transportation sources in order to select the most appropriate and cost-effective sources.
categories.name: Optimize transportation schedules and costs

categories.description: Establishing measures for evaluating the performance of the logistics strategy of the organization. Establish key performance indicators, including the logistics performance index, delivery in full, and delivery on time.
categories.name: Define key performance measures

categories.description: Establish a strategy that includes rules and regulations for the physical handling, information processing, and disposition of product and packaging returned by the buyer to the seller or an intermediary. Include return approval, transportation coordination, advance communication, product tracking, receipt, disposition of the return, and processing warranty claims in the strategy.
categories.name: Define reverse logistics strategy

categories.name_en: Plan and manage inbound material flow
categories.description: Creating and executing a strategy for all the internal activities related to the flow/transfer of inbound materials. This process includes planning inbound material receipts, managing inbound material flow, monitoring inbound delivery performance, managing the flow of returned products, controlling the quality of returned parts, and salvaging or repairing returned products.
categories.name_zh: 计划和管理入厂物料流
categories.name: 计划和管理入厂物料流

categories.description: Managing the receipts of inbound materials. Create a plan accounting for the materials procured from the source of supply and the materials delivered to the distribution center or the warehouse.
categories.name: Plan inbound material receipts

categories.description: Managing all the internal activities related to the flow/transfer of materials. Manage materials being delivered to distribution center or warehouse. Gauge the time taken for delivery and if the delivery process is on time.
categories.name: Manage inbound material flow

categories.description: Overseeing the performance of an inbound delivery system. Check the present delivery system's efficiency, cost effectiveness, and adherence to a delivery schedule.
categories.name: Monitor inbound delivery performance

categories.description: Tracking and taking care of the products that have been internally returned either because of their deficiency or in cases of incorrect delivery.
categories.name: Manage flow of returned products

categories.description: Determining if a returned product can be salvaged or repaired. Salvage or repair is dependent upon the product, the condition of the product, or the availability of a like item.
categories.name: Manage disposition of returned products

categories.description: Implement a checks and balances system to verify that returned parts meet acceptable quality standards to determine appropriate disposition activity.
categories.name: Determine quality of controlled part

categories.description: Executing activities for reinstating the returned products. Present the customer with additional incentives of compensation in case of any defective products delivery or any discrepancy in the product specifications in order to save the order from being permanently returned.
categories.name: Perform salvage activities

categories.description: Administering the reinstatement of the returned product in order to return them back to customers. Repair or remanufacture the defective or ineffective products returned by the customer. Process the delivery of the repaired or remanufactured products back to the customer.
categories.name: Manage repair/refurbishment

categories.description: Moving a returned product back to inventory or stock. Whether a product is sufficient as returned, repaired, or refurbished, moving that product back to inventory for resale or returning to customer is the fnal step in Manage disposition of returned products.
categories.name: Return to finished goods inventory

categories.description: Tracking the inventory deployment. Accept and store products. Ship the products. Measure the accuracy of the inventory. Assess the performance of the outsourced logistics activities.
categories.name: 运作仓储

categories.description: Tracking the logistical act of delivering or releasing an inventory item or entity to targeted end users. Track how much inventory has been deployed at all the distribution centers, individually.
categories.name: Manage and track inventory deployment

categories.name_en: Receive, inspect, and store inbound deliveries
categories.description: Coordinating the incoming inbound materials/products. Accept the delivery of these materials and the subsequent storage. Track them at the warehouse/distribution center.
categories.name: Receive, inspect, and store inbound deliveries

categories.description: Keeping track of the availability of different materials/products at the warehouse and distribution centers.
categories.name: Track product availability

categories.name_en: Pick, pack, and ship product for delivery
categories.description: Packing and shipping the product to deliver to the customer. Take care of the internal and external packaging of the products in order to ensure safe transportation of the products from the warehouse to delivery locations. Notify the ERP system and/or Accounts Receivable Dept.
categories.name: Pick, pack, and ship product for delivery

categories.description: Monitoring any discrepancies between electronic records that represent the inventory and the physical state of the inventory. Look for discrepancies such as phantom inventory, which includes products that an inventory accounting system considers to be available at the storage location but are not actually available.
categories.name: Track inventory accuracy

categories.name_en: Track third-party logistics storage and shipping performance
categories.description: Keeping a track on the storage and shipping performance of third-party agencies. Monitor logistics storage and shipping performance for third-party agencies. Use measures such as a logistics scoreboard, activity-based costing, economic value analysis, and balanced scorecards.
categories.name: Track third-party logistics storage and shipping performance

categories.description: Administering the movement of the finished products that are processed by the organization through its warehouses. Track goods through the use of systems such as barcodes in order to monitor the volumes available, quantity of out-flowing goods, remaining shelf life of the product, etc.--ultimately, to best manage the warehouse capacity.
categories.name: Manage physical finished goods inventory

categories.description: Shipping items from one warehouse to another in a multi-warehouse environment. A warehouse transfer is typically handled electronically in a system designed to replicate the physical processes involved with transferring items from one warehouse to another.
categories.name: Manage warehouse transfers

categories.description: Creating a plan that specifies the schedule and system for transportation and delivery of the outbound products, as well as tracking the performance of the carrier delivery system. Conduct vehicle management and processing of all carrier-related documents.
categories.name: 运作出厂运输

categories.name_en: Plan, transport, and deliver outbound product
categories.description: Organizing the transportation and delivery of outbound products. Plan and organize the transportation, shipping, and delivery of the end products. Create a plan that specifies dispatch and delivery of the product to its destination, as well the transportation.
categories.name: Plan, transport, and deliver outbound product

categories.description: Monitoring delivery performance when carrying products from the warehouse/distribution centers to the retailers or end consumers. Create a performance metrics based on the key performance indicators.
categories.name: Track carrier delivery performance

categories.description: Taking care of a range of functions related to the means of transport used for delivering the end products. Manage vehicle financing, vehicle maintenance, vehicle telematics (tracking and diagnostics), driver management, speed management, fuel management, and health and safety management.
categories.name: Manage transportation fleet

categories.name_en: Process and audit carrier invoices and documents
categories.description: Organizing and inspecting all account statements and any other documentation for the carriers used in delivery. Create, manage, and inspect all documents related to the financial, regulatory, and administrative accounts of all the carriers/freights. Generate receipts for all freight transactions.
categories.name: Process and audit carrier invoices and documents

categories.description: Validating specific service requirements for individual customers. Determine and schedule resource to fulfill these requirements. Provide service to specific individual customers. Ensure the quality of service delivery.
categories.name_zh: 提供最后一公里配送服务
categories.name: 提供最后一公里配送服务

categories.name_en: Confirm specific last mile delivery service requirements for individual customer
categories.description: Acquiring or soliciting information about specific service requirements for individual customers through the customer service function. Obtain information about customer specific requests, process these requests, and create customer profiles to generate a service order.
categories.name: Confirm specific last mile delivery service requirements for individual customer

categories.description: Soliciting or acquiring information using various sources such as databases, customer interactions, and customer request forms. Hand them further up the hierarchy to deal with them. Categorize the user's request, determining if the request is supportable and prioritizing the request.
categories.name: Process customer request

categories.description: Documenting the individual customer service requirements solicited, along with personal information of the customers, in order to generate customized profiles that hasten the delivery process.
categories.name: Create customer profile

categories.description: Designing a short-term agreement between the service provider and customer. One-time services are ordered by the service recipient and resource-related billing is performed upon completion. Use the service order to document service and customer service work.
categories.name: Generate last mile delivery order

categories.name_en: Identify and schedule resources to meet last mile delivery requirements
categories.description: Determining and scheduling the resources required to fulfill customer service requirements. Create a detailed schedule about the service orders and development of these service orders.
categories.name: Identify and schedule resources to meet last mile delivery requirements

categories.description: Developing a plan for sourcing and deploying the resources required to fulfill customer service needs. Document a detailed summary of all types of resources (equipment, finance, personnel, time, etc.) required to complete customer service requests and procure these resources. Identify and assess various sources in order to effectively create a resourcing plan.
categories.name: Create resourcing plan and schedule

categories.name_en: Create last mile delivery service order fulfillment schedule
categories.description: Designing a detailed summary of customer service order requirements, along with information concerning the timing and duration for these services. Categorize the customer needs. Monitor the services delivered.
categories.name: Create last mile delivery service order fulfillment schedule

categories.name_en: Provide last mile delivery service to specific customers
categories.description: Dispatching resources for managing and fulfilling daily service requirements. Manage the progress of order fulfillment. Complete order blocks.
categories.name: Provide last mile delivery service to specific customers

categories.name_en: Organize daily last mile delivery order fulfillment schedule
categories.description: Laying out a daily plan of specific service orders that need to be fulfilled. Document and systematically order these activities to ensure high effectiveness and efficiency.
categories.name: Organize daily last mile delivery order fulfillment schedule

categories.description: Dispatching and delivering the resources needed for the specific service requirements from the source/warehouse. Manage the dispatch, transportation, and delivery of the services.
categories.name: Execute product delivery

categories.name_en: Manage last mile delivery order fulfillment
categories.description: Handling and managing orders fulfilled, along with the orders are not or partially fulfilled to track the order fulfillment progress. Use electronic devices such as trackers and GPS in order track and ensure delivery of the orders.
categories.name: Manage last mile delivery order fulfillment

categories.name_en: Ensure quality of last mile delivery
categories.description: Guaranteeing the quality of service provided to customers. Identify the successful and unsuccessful orders along with the service failures. Collect customer feedback. Process the feedback to ensure the quality of service in the future.
categories.name: Ensure quality of last mile delivery

categories.name_en: Identify completed last mile delivery orders for feedback
categories.description: Determining the service orders that have been successfully delivered. Identify the service orders completed and delivered to the customer. Leverage communication systems to ensure coordination with the customers in order to avoid mishaps.
categories.name: Identify completed last mile delivery orders for feedback

categories.name_en: Identify incomplete last mile delivery orders and last mile delivery service failures
categories.description: Determining orders which have not been completed or delivered. Identify the service orders that are partially or entirely incomplete, as well as the orders that have not been delivered to the customer. Use techniques such as project trackers to recognize the progress of the service orders.
categories.name: Identify incomplete last mile delivery orders and last mile delivery service failures

categories.name_en: Solicit customer feedback on last mile services delivered
categories.description: Obtaining and procuring customer reviews or feedback on the services delivered. Design a customer feedback form, or communicate with the customer through the phone or online.
categories.name: Solicit customer feedback on last mile services delivered

categories.name_en: Process customer feedback on last mile services delivered
categories.description: Assessing and incorporating customer reviews/feedback into the service plan to ensure high quality of service.
categories.name: Process customer feedback on last mile services delivered

categories.description: Offering services to customers. This is the act of providing service delivery as a core business practice and covers identifying strategies for performing service delivery, managing resources, and delivering services to the customer.
categories.name: 交付服务

categories.name_en: Establish service delivery governance and strategies
categories.description: Creating rules and regulations for service delivery to the customer. Establish a system to manage performance, delivery, and direction of service delivery. Engage with the customer for satisfaction feedback. Define goals, policies, processes, and workplace layout and infrastructure as a part of the service delivery strategy.
categories.name_zh: 建立服务交付治理与战略
categories.name: 建立服务交付治理与战略

categories.description: Establishing service delivery governance through a system that manages performance, development, and direction. Allow for customer feedback on delivery satisfaction.
categories.name: 建立服务交付治理

categories.name_en: Set up and maintain service delivery governance and management system
categories.description: Providing a system for which to manage customer needs and a structure for which to facilitate service delivery to fulfill those needs.
categories.name: Set up and maintain service delivery governance and management system

categories.description: Conducting and implementing performance measures to ensure successful delivery of service to the customer.
categories.name: Manage service delivery performance

categories.name_en: Manage service delivery development and direction
categories.description: Providing guidance of resources to ensure that the development and direction of service delivery is in line with customer needs.
categories.name: Manage service delivery development and direction

categories.name_en: Solicit feedback from customer on service delivery satisfaction
categories.description: Engaging the customer post delivery to gauge the effectiveness of services rendered in order to improve on key delivery functions going forward.
categories.name: Solicit feedback from customer on service delivery satisfaction

categories.description: Constructing strategies that identify goals, policies, processes, and procedures in relation to service delivery. Review and validate strategies. Define the workplace layout and infrastructure.
categories.name: 制定服务交付战略

categories.description: Aligning organization practices to meet the needs of the customer by creating service delivery goals.
categories.name: Define service delivery goals

categories.description: Outlining labor policies for resources and ensuring that those policies meet the needs of the organization, the customer, and government regulations.
categories.name: Define labor policies

categories.description: Understanding the needs of the customer and providing the necessary resources to meet those requirements.
categories.name: Evaluate resource availability

categories.name_en: Define service delivery network and supply constraints
categories.description: Identifying and understanding the limitations imposed upon service delivery network and supply.
categories.name: Define service delivery network and supply constraints

categories.description: Defanging policies and procedures that focus on meeting the needs and expectations of the customer within the working parameters of the organization.
categories.name: Define service delivery process

categories.name_en: Review and validate service delivery procedures
categories.description: Revisioning service delivery procedures that fall short of performance parameters. Realign procedures with specified expectations in order to provide successful service delivery.
categories.name: Review and validate service delivery procedures

categories.name_en: Define service delivery workplace layout and infrastructure
categories.description: Creating a workplace that best serves the needs of the organization and customer through strategic layout and infrastructure.
categories.name: Define service delivery workplace layout and infrastructure

categories.description: Understanding the demands on resources and creating a plan to enable the delivery of services via those resources.
categories.name: 管理服务交付资源

categories.description: Ensuring necessary resources are maintained through monitoring pipeline, developing forecasts, and collaborating with customers. Determine skills needed for service deliver and forecast customer orders. Monitor forecasted orders and modify if where needed. Measure forecast accuracy.
categories.name_zh: 管理服务交付资源需求
categories.name: 管理服务交付资源需求

categories.description: Tracking potential opportunities as they move through the various stages of the pipeline.
categories.name: Monitor pipeline

categories.description: Identifying the demand anticipated for the organization's services. Estimate future demand for services using historical data, analysis of the market environment, and external data.
categories.name: Develop baseline forecasts

categories.description: Providing a collaborative meeting in which to engage the customer to understand the scope of their needs and constructing solutions based on need and constraints.
categories.name: Collaborate with customers

categories.description: Arriving at a consensus over the forecasted levels of demand for services by analyzing baseline forecasts and customer input.
categories.name: Develop consensus forecast

categories.name_en: Determine availability of skills to deliver on current and forecast customer orders
categories.description: Identifying what skillset is necessary for the delivery of opportunities. Determine the forecast of customer orders based upon those skillsets and the resources available.
categories.name: Determine availability of skills to deliver on current and forecast customer orders

categories.name_en: Monitor activity against forecast and revise forecast
categories.description: Overseeing all activities necessary to deliver services to customer. Revise forecast to account for any issues that may arise. This could be changes in market trend, resource changes, etc.
categories.name: Monitor activity against forecast and revise forecast

categories.description: Recognizing potential problems in the current forecast and making the necessary changes to align the forecast meet demand.
categories.name: Evaluate and revise forecasting approach

categories.description: Analyzing forecasting against actuals to determine accuracy. Modify forecasting to align with actual need.
categories.name: Measure forecast accuracy

categories.description: Identifying the need for and creating a resource plan. Understand resource demand and align with capacity, skills, and capabilities. Enlist suppliers and partners to supplement needed skills and capabilities. Monitor and manage capabilities and skills with an eye on critical resources and supplier capacity.
categories.name: 创建和管理资源计划

categories.description: Analyzing the skills needed to perform services to be delivered. Classify and organize these skills requirements.
categories.name: Define and manage skills taxonomy

categories.description: Creating a plan to ensure that all resources are available to carry out services required for the customer. This can include physical resources and personnel.
categories.name: Create resource plan

categories.name_en: Match resource demand with capacity, skills, and capabilities
categories.description: Matching demand with skills and capability. Enlisting suppliers and partners to help with demand when needed.
categories.name: Match resource demand with capacity, skills, and capabilities

categories.name_en: Collaborate with suppliers and partners to supplement skills and capabilities
categories.description: Understanding organizational need to enlist suppliers to provide resources for gaps in skills and capabilities. Identify where additional skills are needed and collaborate with third parties to fill those demands.
categories.name: Collaborate with suppliers and partners to supplement skills and capabilities

categories.name_en: Identify critical resources and supplier capacity
categories.description: Realizing critical resources required to perform and carry out customer needs. Engage with suppliers to fulfill those needs, if necessary. Identify supplier threshold for performing those needs.
categories.name: Identify critical resources and supplier capacity

categories.name_en: Monitor and manage resource capacity and availability
categories.description: Directing and managing workforce needs. Ensure that resources are at full capacity. Monitor that all resources are able to skilled in their respective rolls. Make sure that necessary resources are available to provide the needed services.
categories.name: Monitor and manage resource capacity and availability

categories.description: Instituting training to enable resources to provide service delivery to the customer. Develop a training plan. Create materials that provide for operation and technical training. Schedule, perform, and evaluate training.
categories.name: 赋能服务交付资源

categories.description: Creating a detailed summary of all the actions relevant to teaching a person a particular skill or type of behavior. Determine who will deliver the training. Determine when and where the apprentice or trainee needs to go to receive the structured component of the training.
categories.name: Develop service delivery training plan

categories.description: Developing materials necessary to provide comprehensive training for the skills or behavior needed to deliver services. This can be any number for formats such as classroom or computer based training.
categories.name: Develop training materials

categories.description: Providing training to the employee within a manageable timeframe to meet the needs of both the individual and the organization.
categories.name: Manage training schedule

categories.description: Educating service delivery personnel on all aspects of the operations process of the organization.
categories.name: Deliver operations training

categories.description: Ensuring that all personnel are trained on all technical aspects of service delivery to include compliance with constraints on how advanced technologies including artificial intelligence (AI) are used.
categories.name: Deliver technical training

categories.description: Verifying that training provided to the person was successful through the administration testing and the application of skills for practical use.
categories.name: Perform skill and capability testing

categories.description: Eliciting feedback from various sources to evaluate the training provided. This can be achieved through testing and the practical application of skills. Additionally, manager or student feedback can be garnered to evaluate training effectiveness.
categories.name: Evaluate training effectiveness

categories.name_en: Manage and Operate Service Delivery System
categories.description: Managing and operating the systems, resources, and processes used to deliver services to customers, including planning, startup, ongoing operations, and service assurance.
categories.name_zh: 管理和运营服务交付体系
categories.name: 管理和运营服务交付体系

categories.description: Planning the service delivery system by defining service requirements, capacity, resources, and delivery approaches needed to support effective and reliable service provision.
categories.name: 服务交付体系规划

categories.description: Establishing and activating the service delivery system, including preparing resources, processes, and controls required to begin delivering services.
categories.name: 服务交付体系启动

categories.description: Executing day-to-day service delivery activities using the established service delivery system to meet service commitments, performance expectations, and customer needs.
categories.name: 服务交付体系运营

categories.description: Monitoring and assuring service delivery system performance to maintain service quality, reliability, and compliance with defined service standards and expectations.
categories.name_zh: 服务交付体系服务保障
categories.name: 服务交付体系服务保障

categories.description: Rendering service to the customer by initiating, executing, and completing tasks associated with service delivery.
categories.name: 向客户交付服务

categories.description: Collaborating with the customer to understand service needs. Review, understand, and modify the delivery scope with the organization needs of the customer in mind. Confirm readiness and identify, select, and assign resources. Plan for service delivery.
categories.name: 启动服务交付

categories.description: Meeting with the customer, partner, and/or supplier to review the terms of the solutions contract and agree on the terms set forth.
categories.name: Review contract and agreed terms

categories.name_en: Understand customer requirements and define refine approach
categories.description: Taking the customer requirements for a solution and applying those requirements to a refined approach for service.
categories.name: Understand customer requirements and define refine approach

categories.description: Updating the project plan to align with the new solution approach agreed upon with the customer.
categories.name: Modify/revise and approve project plan

categories.description: Aligning the customer business objectives with the agreed service delivery solution.
categories.name: Review customer business objectives

categories.description: Confirming that the organization has the recourses necessary to meet the expectations for the solution for service delivery.
categories.name: Confirm environmental readiness

categories.description: Identifying, selecting, and assigning resources required to deliver service to the customer. Ensure that all objectives are established and met, and the all rules of engagement have been identified and communicated.
categories.name: Identify, select, and assign resources

categories.description: Providing the workforce with a plan of action and goals necessary to provide a service. Make sure that those objectives are met.
categories.name: Establish people objectives

categories.description: Establishing guidelines for how resources engage with the customer. For example, set rules of accountability, interaction, and accommodation when engaging the customer. Resources should be polite, empathetic, and attentive.
categories.name: Establish engagement rules

categories.description: Establishing a plan of action to successfully render a solution for service delivery.
categories.name: Plan for service delivery

categories.description: Carrying out service delivery to the customer by creating and deploying the necessary solution. Analyze need and create a solution. Validate the solution and make changes if needed. Obtain approval to build/buy solution and then deploy solution to customer.
categories.name: 执行服务交付

categories.description: Understanding the needs of the customer and providing the necessary resources to meet those requirements within the scope of the organization.
categories.name: Analyze environment and customer needs

categories.description: Creating a plan of action to provide service delivery to the customer through a possible solution. This solution should be in response to a collaborative effort made by the organization and the customer to meet service delivery needs.
categories.name: Define solution

categories.description: Validating that the proposed solution is feasible and provides the needed services for the customer.
categories.name: Validate solution

categories.description: Realizing issues within the original drafted solution and providing changes to correct those issues.
categories.name: Identify changes

categories.description: Gaining approval from all avenues to proceed with providing solutions for service delivery.
categories.name: Obtain approval to proceed

categories.description: Constructing or purchasing solutions necessary to provide service delivery.
categories.name: Make build/buy solution

categories.description: Providing the customer with promised services and solutions.
categories.name: Deploy solution

categories.description: Implementing final steps to complete service delivery to the customer. Evaluate success through project review, complete finance activities, and confirm delivery. Release resources and manage completion by harvesting knowledge and systems by archiving records.
categories.name: 完成服务交付

categories.name_en: Conduct service delivery/project review and evaluate success
categories.description: Reviewing the entire service delivery process to evaluate the success of the project from beginning to end.
categories.name: Conduct service delivery/project review and evaluate success

categories.description: Insuring all payments are received and all activates therein are completed.
categories.name: Complete/finalize financial management activities

categories.name_en: Confirm delivery according to contract terms
categories.description: Confirming that the organization has satisfied all terms of the delivery contract set forth in collaboration between the organization and customer.
categories.name: Confirm delivery according to contract terms

categories.description: Discharging leveraged resources from service delivery commitments upon completion. Returning resources to the resource pool.
categories.name: Release resources

categories.description: Ensuring that all aspects of the service delivery process are completed both internally and externally.
categories.name: Manage service delivery completion

categories.description: Garnering feedback from all avenues to collect a knowledge base concerning services rendered.
categories.name: Harvest knowledge

categories.description: Completing and archiving all records associated with requested services. Update all necessary systems to reflect those changes.
categories.name: Archive records and update systems
