categories.name: Determine stakeholder requirements

categories.description: Summarize stakeholder requirements into discrete research questions in support of workforce analytics.
categories.name: Identify research questions

categories.description: Consider stakeholder requirements, research questions, and organizations standards around research to select appropriate research methodology in support of workforce analytics.
categories.name: Select workforce analysis methodology

categories.description: Identify appropriate data sources for workforce analytics data while considering organizational standards for data sources.
categories.name: Identify workforce data sources

categories.description: Collect and procure, as needed, workforce data from internal and external data sources in support of workforce analytics.
categories.name: Gather workforce data

categories.description: Transform, develop, and communicate workforce data into analytics in support of organizational requirements.
categories.name: 实施劳动力分析

categories.description: Logically and statistically validate collected or purchased data in support of analytics needs
categories.name: Transform workforce analysis data

categories.name_en: Develop insights into workforce analytics outcomes
categories.description: Synthesize insights from workforce analytics data
categories.name: Develop insights into workforce analytics outcomes

categories.description: Summarize, package, and distribute results of workforce analysis.
categories.name: Communicate workforce analysis outcomes

categories.description: Creating an effective plan that initiates and promotes communication and engagement among the employees and between employees and management.
categories.name: 管理员工沟通

categories.description: Creating a plan for managing communication among employees. Inform employees of direction. Counter resistance with change management approaches. Seek specific areas of input to the decision-making process. Seek varying degrees of involvement and co-creation.
categories.name: 制定员工沟通计划

categories.description: Questioning employees to ascertain overall workplace satisfaction.
categories.name: 开展员工敬业度调研

Plan for and communicate IT services along with establishing IT service levels, providing transformation guidance, and performance analysis that foster IT customer relationships.
categories.name: 开发和管理IT客户关系

Communicate these opportunities to management in order for the improvements to take effect.
categories.name: Develop and maintain improvement processes

categories.description: Managing the IT relationship with its customers by systematically coordinating interactions over multiple touch points on a regular basis. categories.name: Manage IT requirements

categories.name_zh: 定义业务技术与治理战略
categories.name: 定义业务技术与治理战略

categories.name_en: Align IT portfolio to business objectives
categories.description: Aligning IT investments, projects, and activities to achieve overall business objectives.
categories.name: Align IT portfolio to business objectives

Create and establish the rules, regulations, policies, and standards that will govern the individual components of the IT architecture, as well as the architecture in its entirety.
categories.name: Establish and operate enterprise architecture governance

categories.name: Establish IT service management strategy and goals

categories.name_en: Identify IT service operating and process requirements
categories.description: Identifying operating and process requirement for designing, delivering, managing, and improving the way information technology be used in the organization.
categories.name: Identify IT service operating and process requirements

categories.description: Create and design an organized and curated collection of all IT-related services that can be performed by, for, or within the organization.

categories.name: Monitor and analyze IT financial performance

categories.name_en: Monitor and analyze IT value and benefits
categories.description: Examining and analyzing the value and benefits of IT service management to ensure benefits outweigh incurred costs.
categories.name: Monitor and analyze IT value and benefits

categories.name_en: Manage IT projects and services interdependencies

categories.name: Manage IT projects and services interdependencies

categories.name: Report IT service and project performance

categories.name: Select, deploy, and operate IT performance analytics tools

categories.name: 管理IT价值组合

categories.description: Evaluate the value of the investments, projects, and activities of IT function by assigning it a quantifiable value with a profitable return to business operations.
categories.name: Quantify value of IT service and project portfolio investments

categories.name: Communicate business technology value contribution

categories.name_en: Determine and implement IT portfolio adjustments
categories.description: Determining and implementing IT investments, projects, and activities based on trending technological advancements in the existing environment in order to achieve overall business objectives.
categories.name: Determine and implement IT portfolio adjustments

categories.description: Establishing the standard for selecting IT research initiatives to align with organizational criteria for implementing future technologies.
categories.name: Establish selection criteria for research initiatives

categories.name: Analyze emerging technology concepts

categories.description: Identification of conceptual elements that define the benefits of technology to business.
categories.name: Identify technology concepts and capabilities

categories.description: Implement information technology research projects that focus on meeting the goals of the organization's IT services and capabilities.
categories.name: Execute IT research projects

categories.name: Evaluate IT research project outcomes

categories.description: Determine project viability. Promote relevant IT innovations that meet business objectives.
categories.name: Identify and promote viable concepts

categories.description: Develop and plan long-term allocation of funds for information technology endeavors to meet business goals.
categories.name: Develop and plan IT investment projects

categories.name_zh: 开发和管理IT韧性与风险

categories.name_zh: 制定IT合规、风险与安全战略
categories.name: 制定IT合规、风险与安全战略

categories.name: Determine and evaluate IT regulatory and audit requirements

categories.description: Understand the risk tolerance levels of individual business units, given risk-return trade-offs for one or more anticipated and predictable consequences.

categories.description: Assess IT-related risk resilience strategies to ensure that the organization effectively manages its risk.
categories.name: Evaluate IT-related risks resiliency

categories.name_en: Create IT risk mitigation strategies and approaches
categories.description: Developing activities to improve performance opportunities and lessen threats in IT. Evolve strategies and policies to attain organizational objectives.

categories.name_en: Align IT risk management with cybersecurity frameworks

categories.name: Align IT risk management with cybersecurity frameworks

categories.name_en: Integrate IT and OT risk management strategies
categories.description: Ensure risk management processes are extended to cover OT systems and environments.

categories.description: Determining resilience strategies to ensure that IT effectively manages it's delivery process to mitigate risk.

categories.name: Determine critical IT risks

categories.description: Prioritize potential IT risks based on business need to ensure overall IT stability.
categories.name: Prioritize IT risks

categories.name_en: Establish mitigation approaches for IT risks
categories.description: Establishing activities to improve opportunities and lessen threats for IT.
categories.name: Establish mitigation approaches for IT risks

Implement proactive measures such as threat intelligence, vulnerability management, and OT-specific controls to safeguard the organization’s IT and OT environments. This is inclusive of all forms of new and evolving technology such as artificial intelligence (AI).

categories.name_en: Evaluate enterprise regulatory and compliance obligations
categories.description: Evaluation of dynamic, strategic, and integrated approach to manage regulatory requirements and compliance obligations.
categories.name: Evaluate enterprise regulatory and compliance obligations

categories.description: Analyzing the impact of threats to critical IT assets across different departments and functions in the organization in terms of quantifiable results.

categories.name: Create and maintain IT security policies, standards, and procedures

categories.description: Develop and implement training in regard to managing IT risks, understanding criticality, impact, and opportunities associated with business objectives.
categories.name: Develop and deploy risk management training

categories.name_en: Establish risk reporting capabilities and responsibilities
categories.description: Establishing processes to communicate IT risk to the organization.
categories.name: Establish risk reporting capabilities and responsibilities

categories.description: Establishing standards for communications within the organization which creates the road map for successful understanding of strategic initiatives for both business units and information technology services.
categories.name: Establish communication standards

categories.name_en: Conduct IT risk and threat assessments
categories.description: Evaluate IT risk and threat assessments by way of IT assets, information security, and breach points within the organization.
categories.name: Conduct IT risk and threat assessments

categories.name_en: Monitor and manage IT activity risk
categories.description: Monitoring and managing risks related to IT adoption within the organization.
categories.name: Monitor and manage IT activity risk

categories.name_en: Identify, supervise and monitor IT risk mitigation measures
categories.description: Identifying and supervising a blueprint of measures for managing risk in IT. Monitor actions to enhance opportunities and reduce threats to project objectives.
categories.name: Identify, supervise and monitor IT risk mitigation measures

categories.description: Planning and managing the organization’s ability to recover from exposure to internal and external threats, with a focus on IT and cybersecurity. categories.name: 规划和管理IT连续性

categories.description: Integrating the disciplines of Emergency Response, Crisis Management, Disaster Recovery (technology continuity) and Business Continuity for IT.

categories.description: Creating and deploying an architecture for securing and ensuring the privacy of data flows throughout the organization. Develop and implement protocols and policies to protect IT and OT environments, aligned with global standards. Incorporate modern security paradigms, such as Zero Trust Architecture, to ensure the safe use of IT services and solutions.
categories.name_zh: 开发和管理IT安全、隐私与数据保护
categories.name: 开发和管理IT安全、隐私与数据保护

categories.name_en: Assess IT regulatory and confidentiality requirements and policies

categories.name: Assess IT regulatory and confidentiality requirements and policies

categories.description: Defining and managing organization's approach to governing IT security and ensuring the privacy of data flows throughout the organization. Establish and manage tools to support the governance process in order to avoid misuse of information and breach of organizational privacy.
categories.name: Create IT security, privacy, and data protection risk governance

categories.name_en: Define IT data security and privacy policies, standards, and procedures
categories.description: Outlining and establishing policies, regulations, standards, and procedures for IT data security and privacy.
categories.name: Define IT data security and privacy policies, standards, and procedures

categories.description: Identifying, examining, and reviewing physical and logical IT data security measures such as hardware security (smart cards), cryptographic protocols, and access control.
categories.name: Review and monitor physical and logical IT data security measures

categories.name_en: Review and monitor application security controls
categories.description: Identifying, examining, and reviewing security control for IT applications. Test, analyze, and implement security protocols in order to safeguard IT applications.
categories.name: Review and monitor application security controls

categories.name_en: Review and monitor IT physical environment security controls
categories.description: Identifying and examining security controls for physical environment of information technology such as business facilities, equipment, and resources.
categories.name: Review and monitor IT physical environment security controls

categories.description: Monitoring and evaluating network intrusion detection for any malicious activity or policy violations. Identify the gaps in order to resolve threats and enhance existing network security.
categories.name: Monitor/analyze network intrusion detection data and resolve threats

categories.name: Schedule/optimize backup and archive activities

categories.description: Balancing workloads of all the processes and services that are provisioned to their internal or external clients, across available components of IT infrastructure. No component should be over or under utilized with the workflow of the IT operations.
categories.name: Balance operational workloads across available infrastructure components

categories.description: Determining process and procedure to provide support for specific IT service problems.
categories.name: Determine specific problem support procedures

categories.name_en: Develop and manage infrastructure resource planning
categories.description: Developing and managing the resources required for administration of infrastructure. Manage the IT inventory and assets to meet organization's IT resource capacity.
categories.name_zh: 开发和管理基础设施资源规划
categories.name: 开发和管理基础设施资源规划

categories.description: Creating a strategy for delivering IT services and solutions. Establish the sourcing strategy. Establish the delivery process procedures and tools. Examine and choose the most effective methodologies and tools.
categories.name: Develop IT service delivery strategy

categories.description: Assessing the goals and objectives of IT infrastructure and how it contributes to the overall business objectives.
categories.name: Assess IT infrastructure business objectives

categories.description: Determining existing IT infrastructure capabilities. Identify the gaps and needs in order to enhance the existing IT infrastructure to meet growth objectives.
categories.name: Determine ongoing IT infrastructure capabilities

categories.description: Identify the gaps and needs of existing IT infrastructure. Plan and develop strategies to upgrade/replace existing IT infrastructure.
categories.name: Plan IT infrastructure change

categories.name_en: Plan and budget IT license usage volumes
categories.description: Creating a plan associated with usage volumes of IT licenses. Develop a framework to govern the licensing of an IT services along with identified usage volumes. Determine the amount of investment in IT license usage volumes and how would the license volumes be financed.
categories.name: Plan and budget IT license usage volumes

categories.description: Develop strategies and methodologies to provide service support. Examine service levels, support complexity, stakeholder requirements to offer service support.
categories.name: 定义服务支持规划

categories.description: Evaluate criticality catered by the IT support and expectations to resolve raised or identified issues. Determine the usual requests received for IT support for each area of IT operations. Ensure resolution to every identified or reported issue within specified SLAs.
categories.name: Understand IT support demand patterns

categories.name_en: Determine required support resource levels, responsibilities, and capabilities
categories.description: Determining levels of required support resources along with their responsibilities, and capabilities to resolve IT issues. Evaluate and ensure that support resources are fulfilling their responsibilities n a timely manner.
categories.name: Determine required support resource levels, responsibilities, and capabilities

categories.description: Create and maintain service support knowledge repository. Store, maintain, access, revise, and use knowledge for IT services. Review knowledge trends and implement knowledge transfer methodologies for competitive advantage.
categories.name: Maintain service support knowledge repository

categories.description: Maintaining and transfer of knowledge towards service support with the change/upgrade in technology over a stipulated period. Ensure IT staff is well trained and tested on the new learning of service support.
categories.name: Maintain service support learning

categories.description: Conveying service support needs within the organization, with the objective of providing required support services. Define processes and procedures needed to support users of IT services and solutions. Convey these procedures to appropriate governing authority.
categories.name: Communicate service support needs

categories.description: Determining mechanisms to report for a higher degree of decision making depending on the criticality of IT escalations. Define the processes and procedures needed to follow for IT escalation at different levels. Convey the mechanisms within the organization.
categories.name: Define IT escalation mechanisms

categories.description: Managing resources required for administration of IT service support. Establish sources that will make use of e-mail, live support software online, or a tool where users can log a call or incident in order to retrieve IT support.
categories.name: Manage IT service support resources

categories.description: Developing a strategy that will make use of multiple resources to coordinate with external support providers in order to make the support services work more smoother.
categories.name: Coordinate with external support providers

categories.description: Sorting the incidents of IT service delivery in certain order so that the services could be delivered based on the criticality.
categories.name: Triage IT service delivery incidents

categories.description: Defining methodology and frequency of assessment for measuring and monitoring performance of various processes and activities of IT service support against standard set goals.
categories.name: Monitor IT service support performance

categories.name_en: Develop and manage service delivery operations
categories.description: Developing and managing different delivery services using service delivery systems for operational activities within the IT function in order to achieve organizations goal.
categories.name_zh: 开发和管理服务交付运营
categories.name: 开发和管理服务交付运营

categories.description: Operating and defining methodology of assessment for measuring and monitoring performance of online systems against its expected result.
categories.name: Operate and monitor online systems

categories.name_en: Run and monitor batch job schedule
categories.description: Operate and monitor the application of scheduling batch jobs to be run in the background at a certain date and time.
categories.name: Run and monitor batch job schedule

categories.description: Analyze and manage workload needs in relation to service delivery. Plan resources and mechanism around those workload needs so that services could be delivered smoothly.
categories.name: Manage service delivery workloads

categories.description: Managing the performance and capacity of infrastructure by using key performance indicators to routinely track the performance and capacity levels. Review performance. Evaluate the efficiency and effectiveness of the infrastructure.
categories.name: Manage infrastructure performance and capacity

categories.description: Addressing to an issue in operational activities within the IT function, that occur outside of normal routine or preventative maintenance.
categories.name: Respond to unplanned operational issues

categories.description: Identify and introduce resources to display output in a viewable form to key decision makers and evaluators.
categories.name: Produce and distribute output media

categories.description: Identifying, examining, and recognizing any flaw or breach in security of IT infrastructure. Ensure that protocols and guidelines for individual IT components are being followed and there is no misuse of information and breach of individual or organizational privacy.
categories.name: Monitor IT infrastructure security

categories.description: Managing resources of IT infrastructure and their recovery capacity. Manage storage, computer hardware, software, and infrastructure resources that can be stored as inventory or provided by the organization as needed. Managing backup/recovery for IT services and solutions. Use a backup system or application.
categories.name: Manage IT infrastructure/data recovery

categories.description: Managing the resources required for administration of IT infrastructure. Manage the IT inventory and assets. Take care of the organization's IT resource capacity.
categories.name_zh: 管理基础设施资源行政
categories.name: 管理基础设施资源行政

categories.description: Identifying and tracking individual configuration items, documenting functional capabilities and interdependencies of IT infrastructure. Determining the gaps and needs in order to enhance existing infrastructure configuration.
categories.name: Manage infrastructure configuration

categories.description: Evaluating and maintaining all aspects of infrastructure component maintenance. Ensure that all components of an IT infrastructure are functioning properly as per the expectation. Maintenance includes all preventative, routine, and corrective measures.
categories.name: Perform infrastructure component maintenance

categories.description: Installing/configuring/upgrading all the components required for operational activities within IT infrastructure. Ensure that all components of an IT infrastructure are functioning properly and updated to latest version/technology.
categories.name: Install/configure/upgrade infrastructure components

categories.description: Maintaining the complete list of IT items or resources available with the organization with the details on date of purchase, licenses, deployment and SLAs.
categories.name: Maintain IT asset records

categories.description: Administering and overseeing the terms and policies associated with licensing the IT intellectual property. Create and manage the policies and terms governing the possible granting of a license to any external agent. Demarcate a clear framework that governs the licensing of any patents or copyrights held by the organization.
categories.name: Administer IT licenses/user agreements

categories.name_en: Provide IT infrastructure service and capabilities
categories.description: Providing all the infrastructure services and capabilities required for operational activities within the IT function supporting overall business objectives.
categories.name: Provide IT infrastructure service and capabilities

categories.description: Managing systematic user support functionality and capability through defined procedures. Determine, record, and monitor user requests. Execute issue/request resolution. Utilize escalation path when needed. Resolve issue/request.
categories.name: 运营IT用户支持

categories.description: Evaluate and assign IT issues/requests accordingly to allow for the correct routing of IT issues to the relevant support teams.
categories.name: Triage IT issues/requests

categories.description: Providing the necessary skills and competencies required to efficiently provide IT resolution through the support structure.
categories.name: Provide IT resolution capabilities

categories.description: Creating an effective plan and structure to address and resolve requests of IT users. Determine, record, and monitor user requests. Obtain information about the effectiveness and performance of the user request handling process from the IT users through various means.
categories.name: Manage IT user requests

categories.description: Follow processes and procedures to escalate IT requests to required levels for resolution or effective decision making when necessary.
categories.name: Escalate IT requests

categories.description: Creating a structure to resolve issues/requests of IT services using different mechanisms.
categories.name: Resolve IT issues/requests

categories.name_en: Execute IT continuity and recovery action
categories.description: Successfully implement preventive measures to manage IT risk of exposure to internal and external threats. Integrating the disciplines of Emergency Response, Crisis Management, Disaster Recovery (technology continuity) and Business Continuity for IT.
categories.name: Execute IT continuity and recovery action

categories.description: Overseeing key back-office processes for organizations. This category includes process groups related to planning and management accounting, revenue accounting, general accounting and reporting, fixed-asset project accounting, payroll, accounts payable and expense reimbursements, treasury operations, internal controls, tax management, international funds/consolidation, and global trade services.
categories.name: 管理财务资源

categories.description: Determining different stages of the planning process and accounting. Classify, determine, analyze, interpret, and communicate information to make up-to-date business decisions for better management and control functions.
categories.name: 执行规划与管理会计

categories.name_en: Develop and manage financial resources strategy
categories.description: Ensuring the effective allocation, utilization, and sustainability of financial assets. Activities include analyzing internal and external financial drivers; identifying long-term funding needs; evaluating investment, capital, and liquidity requirements; and defining guiding financial principles that support enterprise objectives.
categories.name_zh: 制定和管理财务资源战略
categories.name: 制定和管理财务资源战略

categories.description: Allocating funds to meet future and current financial goals. Led by the chief financial officer, have the finance function plan, budget, and forecast in order to determine and describe long and short-term financial goals.
categories.name: 执行规划/预算/预测

categories.name_en: Develop and maintain budget policies and procedures
categories.description: Formulating financial budgetary guidelines and strategies. Develop a framework for rules and regulations regarding budgets. Create a step-by-step process to achieve financial goals.
categories.name: Develop and maintain budget policies and procedures

categories.description: Creating reports on a quarterly or annual basis for fund allocation. Create a financial statement that estimates revenues and expenses over a specific period of time. (Leverage budget methods such as cost-based and zero-based budgeting techniques, in light of the periodic targets outlined during Develop and maintain budget policies and procedures [10771].)
categories.name: Prepare periodic budgets and plans

categories.name_en: Operationalize and implement plans to achieve budget
categories.description: Putting budgeting plans into practical use keeping within designated forecasting parameters.
categories.name: Operationalize and implement plans to achieve budget

categories.description: Creating estimates of the projected income and expenses required over a predetermined time frame. Develop the projections of profit and loss statements, balance sheets, and the cash flow forecast.
categories.name: Prepare periodic financial forecasts

categories.name_en: Perform variance analysis against forecasts and budgets
categories.description: Conducting a quantitative analysis between what was forecasted and budgeted and actual financial behavior.
categories.name: Perform variance analysis against forecasts and budgets

categories.description: Defining costs to be incurred and methods for optimum utilization. Determine the costs of products, processes, projects, etc. to compile in the financial statements, as well as to assist management in making decisions regarding planning and control. Control costs by managing and reducing business expenses.
categories.name: 执行成本会计与控制

categories.description: Conducting accounting for assets, and finding reasons for changes (depreciation, obsolescence, deterioration, change in customer taste, increased demand, decreased market supply, etc.).
categories.name: Perform inventory accounting

categories.description: Determining the revenue, profits, and losses incurred by each unit within the organization that produces profit.
categories.name: Perform profit center accounting

categories.description: Studying expenses directly associated with product. Analyze the cost of sales, which is the cost of manufacturing products.
categories.name: Perform cost of sales analysis

categories.description: Studying and finding out the relevant cost center for a product by studying every resource used in its making.
categories.name: Perform product costing

categories.description: Discovering the changes between forecasted and actual costing. Analyze actual and planned behavior by reviewing the amount of a variance on a trend line in order to maintain control over a business.
categories.name: Perform variance analysis

categories.description: Making a report about revenues generated by the organization or business unit concerned. This process requires the organization to create a report which shows how business is generating profits. Profits are the part which is left after paying all expenses directly related to the generation of the revenue, such as producing a product, and other expenses related to conducting business activities.
categories.name: Report on profitability

categories.description: Deciding which expenses can be avoided to reduce some costs and increase revenues. Plan and control the organization's budget to forecast future expenditures.
categories.name: 执行成本管理

categories.description: Defining cost drivers for a particular activity.
categories.name: Determine key cost drivers

categories.description: Calculating cost drivers.
categories.name: Measure cost drivers

categories.description: Determine the activities that hinder the progress of finance activities. This requires the organization to determine those business activities carried out by the financial function of the organization and which are indispensable. This undertaking helps the organization triangulate those activities which are essential and where costs cannot be slashed.
categories.name: Determine critical activities

categories.name_en: Manage asset resource deployment and utilization
categories.description: Distributing or allocating asset resources in different processes for optimal utilization.
categories.name: Manage asset resource deployment and utilization

categories.description: Checking and achieving predetermined financial targets and timelines. Assess and manage the profitability, feasibility, and consistency of a business or project. Study the revenues generated.
categories.name: 评估和管理财务绩效

categories.description: Studying product demand and targeted customer preferences. Study customers' demands or preferences after deducting the cost of delivering the final product.
categories.name: Assess customer and product profitability

categories.description: Checking demand about a specific product by a customer segment. Conduct a detailed study--or research a customer behavior or preference for a product--in order to determine its production and profitability in a specific market.
categories.name: Evaluate new products

categories.description: Determining the cost of delivering an end product at different stages of production. Study the total life cycle of a product/process to determine how much revenue and production cost will be incurred at every stage in order to make strategic decisions.
categories.name: Perform life cycle costing

categories.description: Creating the best fit between a product and the end user. Maximize the customer base by providing different products in the market.
categories.name: Optimize customer and product mix

categories.name_en: Track performance of new-customer and product strategies
categories.description: Observing the behavior of a new set of customers for different products. Prepare strategies to improve sales and profits.
categories.name: Track performance of new-customer and product strategies

categories.description: Evaluating performance based on different sets of activities created by management to measure performance.
categories.name: Prepare activity-based performance measures

categories.description: Conducting activities to improve cost distribution regularly. Follow or adopt different ways of reducing costs.
categories.name: Manage continuous cost improvement

categories.description: Comparing revenue targets to reality. Review all transactions and entries passed in final accounts in a year in order to examine profits.
categories.name: 执行收入核算

categories.description: Evaluating and processing requests for advances. Evaluate credit requests by customers requiring loans to buy products/services.
categories.name: 处理客户信用

categories.description: Creating guidelines for providing advances. Set up credit standards, credit terms, and collection policies.
categories.name: Establish credit policies

categories.description: Checking and accepting new requests based on eligibility criteria. Analyze the status of applicants and requirements to be met for a new account.
categories.name: Analyze/Approve new account applications

categories.description: Reviewing past credit scores to determine the if a line of credit will be extended to potential customers. This could also include extending additional credit to existing accounts.
categories.name: Analyze credit scoring history

categories.description: Planning credit score requirements based on established credit policies.
categories.name: Forecast credit scoring requirement

categories.description: Evaluating existing account holders and their past performance. Regularly review existing accounts to get the required information about the status at present.
categories.name: Review existing accounts

categories.description: Preparing account payable reports about payments to be made according to accounting rules and principles, and providing the reports to management.
categories.name: Produce credit/collection reports

categories.name_en: Reinstate or suspend accounts based on credit policies
categories.description: Closing or restarting accounts according to changes made in credit policies.
categories.name: Reinstate or suspend accounts based on credit policies

categories.description: Preparing detailed reports of customer purchases. Prepare a commercial document between the seller and customer with details about transaction. Detail the quantity purchased, price of products/services, date, parties involved, unique invoice number, and tax information.
categories.name: 开具客户发票

categories.description: Creating and updating a record of customers and the products being purchased by them in a database. This process element requires the organization to maintain a database of customers and their purchases. Such a master-file can be used to ensure customer touch point, enhance customer satisfaction, explore cross selling opportunities, and identify future trends. This database will include several particulars about the personal details of the organization's customers and a tracking of the products being sold.
categories.name: Maintain customer/product master files

categories.description: Preparing detailed reports about products purchased by customers. Record and generate a detail account of transactions made by customers fat a particular time and location. Include all details about products such as price, quantity, and name.
categories.name: Generate customer billing data

categories.description: Providing information to customers about purchases made by them. Communicate the details of purchases. Provide customers with a copy of details for their reference.
categories.name: Transmit billing data to customers

categories.description: Registering transactions and their scheduled payments.
categories.name: Post receivable entries

categories.description: Checking and solving billing queries raised by customers.
categories.name: Resolve customer billing inquiries

categories.description: Processing payments due from customers. This includes all processing of funds received, whether by check or electronically. This does not include the generation of invoices.
categories.name: 处理应收账款(AR)

categories.description: Creating rules and regulations to be followed in case of credit sales to customers. Create rules and procedures to follow at the time of sale (e.g., the allowable number of installments).
categories.name: Establish AR policies

categories.description: Collecting cash from customers. Deposit it into bank account. Make entries into the books of accounts.
categories.name: Receive/Deposit customer payments

categories.description: Checking and moving funds between countries for business activities, typically through authorized remittance agents.
categories.name: Apply cash remittances

categories.description: Preparing reports that detail balances due or what to collect from customers at a certain point in time.
categories.name: Prepare AR reports

categories.name_en: Post AR activity to the general ledger
categories.description: Preparing the general ledger for account receivables from journals. Place all journal entries related to accounts receivables in the general ledger accounts of a business.
categories.name: Post AR activity to the general ledger

categories.description: Posting entries to respective accounts, and preparing accounts for receivables. Manage the cash collected by the business from its debtors. Record it in the books of accounts to provide clear information about the availability of the cash.
categories.name: 管理与处理催收

categories.description: Creating a process to follow in case of a failed payment by account holders. Create rules and regulations for the account holder who has failed to make at least the minimum monthly payment by the due date.
categories.name: Establish policies for delinquent accounts

categories.description: Examining balance statements of accountholders who failed to make required payments. Study or review the account details of customers' past payments when preparing negotiations policies.
categories.name: Analyze delinquent account balances

categories.description: Determine ways for customers in default to repay debts (e.g., allowing more time or discounts).
categories.name: Correspond/Negotiate with delinquent accounts

categories.name_en: Discuss account resolution with internal parties
categories.description: Determining rules for handling accounts. Discuss and plan with internal parties (department heads, managers, and senior management) about rules to follow in coming months.
categories.name: Discuss account resolution with internal parties

categories.description: Maintaining reserves for write-offs and adjustments. Adjust or write off certain expenses and losses.
categories.name: Process adjustments/write off balances

categories.description: Renegotiating the terms of a loan agreement in order to recoup money from a default account.
categories.name: Perform recovery workout

categories.description: Managing accounts that have not met the requirements agreed upon to pay off outstanding debts.
categories.name: Manage default accounts

categories.description: Creating and providing funds for necessary adjustments and deductions, including all expenses that were required for the business at certain point in time.
categories.name: 管理与处理调整/抵扣

categories.description: Creating guidelines to follow in case of adjustments to business processes.
categories.name: Establish policies/procedures for adjustments

categories.description: Checking changes made in accounts during the year. Examine the alterations made in final accounts to rectify errors/omissions.
categories.name: Analyze adjustments

categories.description: Providing suitable offers to customers. Present different offers (e.g., discounts) available for customers or buyers.
categories.name: Correspond/Negotiate with customer

categories.description: Discussing and planning with internal parties (department heads, managers, and senior management) about rules to follow in coming months.
categories.name: Discuss resolution with internal parties

categories.description: Creating a mechanism for consumer protection in case of a higher price charged. When a supplier sells a product at a higher price to the distributor than the price they have set with the end user, submit a chargeback to the supplier to recover the money lost in the transaction.
categories.name: Prepare chargeback invoices

categories.description: Recording business transactions as they occur in order to provide a balanced accounts for financial reporting.
categories.name: Process related entries

categories.description: Making statements about business activities and functions. Prepare financial statements (balance sheet, income statement, statement of cash flows, and statement of stockholders' equity) according to accounting concepts and principles.
categories.name: 执行总账会计与报告

categories.description: Creating procedures to perform general accounting and reporting. Follow the rules and regulations made for a particular process in the business. Publish accounting policies.
categories.name: 管理财务政策与程序

categories.description: Agreeing upon terms and conditions. Negotiate an agreement between two or more parties, the customer and service providers. Specify scope, quality, and responsibilities.
categories.name: Negotiate service-level agreements

categories.description: Establishing policies and procedures to prepare financial statements, including methods, measurement systems, and procedures for providing disclosures.
categories.name: Establish accounting policies

categories.description: Creating a written copy of agreed-upon procedures for preparing financial statements, and making them available to the public.
categories.name: Publish accounting policies

categories.description: Implementing parameters for accounting. Apply set conditions for any approval process.
categories.name: Set and enforce approval limits

categories.description: Establishing processes and procedures to exercise financial control and accountability. Record, verify, and report transactions that affect revenues, expenditures, assets, and liabilities.
categories.name: Establish common financial systems

categories.description: Applying basic principles, concepts, and accounting practices in recording and preparing final accounts, and using accounting information in management.
categories.name: 执行总账会计

categories.description: Preparing trial balance account from general ledgers. List all accounts used in the general ledger. Alter accounts according to business requirements.
categories.name: Maintain chart of accounts

categories.description: Making ledger and trial balance accounts from journal entries. This process requires the organization to record every transaction into accounts done by business. It is a base documents for preparing final accounts of company.
categories.name: Process journal entries

categories.description: Allocating funds across functions. Apportion funds in line with the budgets created. Formalize allocations in centralized internal records.
categories.name: Process allocations

categories.description: Updating journal entries to adjust the balance of income and expenses at the end of an accounting period.
categories.name: Process period end adjustments

categories.description: Checking accounts separately for a parent and subsidiary company. Manage relationship between a parent company and subsidiaries. Document intercompany transactions in separate financial statements.
categories.name: Post and reconcile intercompany transactions

categories.description: Reviewing general ledger accounts for a parent and subsidiaries companies. Validate the integrity of account balances on the company's general ledger of accounts. Review and compare general ledger accounts balances with source documents to ensure that balances match.
categories.name: Reconcile general ledger accounts

categories.description: Aggregating different processes in the business. Eliminate discontinued processes.
categories.name: Perform consolidations and process eliminations

categories.description: Balancing debit and credit balances of trial balance to preparing final accounts. Calculate the total debits and credits in company's accounts. Correspond the sum of all debits with the sum of all credits. Adjust entries as appropriate.
categories.name: Prepare trial balance

categories.description: Accounting for changes due to country-level policy changes. Record adjustments made by management in the accounts.
categories.name: Prepare and post management adjustments

categories.description: Accounting for long-term and fixed assets. Record purchased, fixed assets that are not easily convertible into cash. Account for costs, useful life, resale value, depreciation, and amortization.
categories.name: 执行固定资产会计

categories.description: Creating rules for fixed assets market valuation. Make rules and regulations for fixed assets regarding depreciation, provisions, resale, usage, etc.
categories.name: Establish fixed-asset policies and procedures

categories.description: Keeping reports up-to-date regarding fixed assets. Create a fixed assets database detailing price, life cycle, depreciation rate, resale value, installation information, usage information, etc.
categories.name: Maintain fixed-asset master data files

categories.name_en: Process and record fixed-asset additions and retires
categories.description: Keeping a summary of sales and purchases of assets. Record any expenses made for new assets purchased and sales of any old assets during the fiscal year.
categories.name: Process and record fixed-asset additions and retires

categories.name_en: Process and record fixed-asset adjustments, enhancements, revaluations, and transfers
categories.description: Keeping a summary of expenses for installing and modifying assets. Record any expenses made for new assets purchased, any expenses incurred on improvements, the valuation of assets to reach current market price, and any transfer assets from one location to another during the fiscal year.
categories.name: Process and record fixed-asset adjustments, enhancements, revaluations, and transfers

categories.name_en: Process and record fixed-asset maintenance and repair expenses
categories.description: Maintaining a record of expenses necessitated for repairs and the preservation of assets. Administer and oversee the maintenance and repair of any fixed assets. Record all related transactions.
categories.name: Process and record fixed-asset maintenance and repair expenses

categories.description: Carrying out accounting for depreciation over fixed assets. Compute the sums necessitated. Maintain a record of the cost value of fixed assets over their useful life in the book of accounts.
categories.name: Calculate and record depreciation expense

categories.description: Balancing the ledger account balance for fixed assets. Correct errors in the books of fixed assets. Provide correct information in relevant accounts.
categories.name: Reconcile fixed-asset ledger

categories.description: Checking and updating the record of all raw materials and fixed assets. Track all fixes asset. Maintain a record of all inventory items.
categories.name: Track fixed-assets including physical inventory

categories.name_en: Provide fixed-asset data to support tax, statutory, and regulatory reporting
categories.description: Showing market value and related expenses on fixed assets data for taxation. Provide complete information recorded in the books of fixed assets about purchase price, depreciation, installation charges, resale market value etc. for tax and regulatory purposes.
categories.name: Provide fixed-asset data to support tax, statutory, and regulatory reporting

categories.description: Reporting on the organization's financial status to stakeholders. Include balance sheets, income statements, cash flow statements, and statements of shareholders' equity.
categories.name: 执行财务报告

categories.description: Making reports of subsidiaries units to show profits generated from them. Prepare financial statements (balance sheets, income statements, cash flow statements and statements of shareholders' equity) for a single unit of a business.
categories.name: Prepare business unit financial statements

categories.description: Making final accounts for all units of company together. Prepare combined financial statements of a parent company and its subsidiaries (i.e., separate legal entities controlled by a parent company) showing assets, liabilities, equity, income, expenses, and cash flows.
categories.name: Prepare consolidated financial statements

categories.name_en: Perform business unit reporting/review management reports
categories.description: Making reports for units/subsidiaries to help management in decision making. Prepare financial statements (balance sheets, income statements, cash flow statements, and statements of shareholders' equity) for a single unit of a business. Break down profits and losses by function/unit, clients, products, and region.
categories.name: Perform business unit reporting/review management reports

categories.name_en: Perform consolidated reporting/review of cost management reports
categories.description: Making reports for all units to help higher management in decision making. Prepare combined financial statements of a parent company and its all subsidiaries (separate legal entities controlled by a parent company) showing assets, liabilities, equity, income, expenses and cash flows, and also going through periodic reports which shows the actual and estimated costs and their variances.
categories.name: Perform consolidated reporting/review of cost management reports

categories.description: Preparing a draft of financial statements for the board to review before they are sent to the auditor.
categories.name: Prepare statements for board review

categories.name_en: Produce quarterly/annual filings and shareholder reports
categories.description: Making and presenting financial reports to stakeholders. Create annual and quarterly financial statements for reporting purposes. Prepare shareholder reports with details of the profit-and-loss account, balance sheet, and past year's business activities.
categories.name: Produce quarterly/annual filings and shareholder reports

categories.description: Reporting raw or summary data for final accounts following rules and regulations.
categories.name: Produce regulatory reports

categories.description: Carrying out activities associated with legal and management consolidation. Legal consolidation can include currency conversion, balance carry forward, and consolidation of journal entries. Management consolidation can include reporting on financials on a reporting cycle basis to gauge the performance of the organization.
categories.name: Perform legal and management consolidation

categories.description: Managing accounts for large funds-invested projects. Manage and account for fixed assets projects (capital projects), which required significant capital investments over many years.
categories.name_zh: 管理固定资产项目会计
categories.name: 管理固定资产项目会计

categories.name_en: Perform capital planning and project approval
categories.description: Preparing a project finance report to solicit approvals in capital projects. Prepare budgets for projects that require heavy investments. Report on project finances to solicit approvals from management.
categories.name_zh: 执行资本规划与项目审批
categories.name: 执行资本规划与项目审批

categories.name_en: Develop capital investment policies and procedures
categories.description: Creating procedures and policies to follow for investing in capital projects. Create rules and regulations regarding large investment plans, which require in-depth forecasting for expenditure and revenue.
categories.name: Develop capital investment policies and procedures

categories.name_en: Develop and approve capital expenditure plans and budgets
categories.description: Creating budgets, and soliciting approvals for capital projects. Prepare budgets for projects that require heavy investments. Secure approvals from management.
categories.name: Develop and approve capital expenditure plans and budgets

categories.name: 维持业务连续性

categories.name_en: Share knowledge of specific risks across other parts of the organization
categories.description: Sharing information about risks and resilience strategies of business operations across the organization so that prospective risks can be avoided.
categories.name_zh: 在组织内共享特定风险的知识
categories.name: 在组织内共享特定风险的知识

categories.description: Fostering external relationships with stakeholders of the entity, including investors, government and industry, the board of directors, and the general public. This is not related to customer management.
categories.name: 管理外部关系

categories.description: Creating a strategic management responsibility for integrating finance, communication, marketing, and securities law compliance. Allow the most effective two-way communication among the organization, the financial community, and other constituencies. Enlist the investor relations function to provide market intelligence to corporate management.
categories.name: 建立投资者关系

categories.name_en: Plan, build, and manage lender relations
categories.description: Building and managing relations with bankers or lenders through strong products/services strategies that bankers would want to invest in. Foster a receptive environment for low rates of interest, easy access to loans, etc.
categories.name_zh: 规划、建立和管理贷款方关系
categories.name: 规划、建立和管理贷款方关系

categories.name_en: Plan, build, and manage analyst relations
categories.description: Creating and maintaining long-term relations with analysts. Involve analysts in strategy and product decisions in order to elicit valuable information.
categories.name_zh: 规划、建立和管理分析师关系
categories.name: 规划、建立和管理分析师关系

categories.description: Practicing regular, transparent communication with shareholders through annual shareholders' meetings, quarterly earnings calls, shareholders letters, one-on-one emails or calls, etc.
categories.name: 与股东沟通

categories.description: Creating and maintaining relationships with government and industry representatives.
categories.name: 管理政府与行业关系

categories.description: Persuading public and government policy at the local, regional, national, and global level (subject to government regulations).
categories.name: 管理政府关系

categories.description: Ascertaining how the business entity relates to all levels of government. Identify areas that needs further growth and resources to foster those relationships.
categories.name: Assess relationships

categories.description: Assigning executive level resources to manage, grow, and drive relationships with government bodies.
categories.name: Appoint responsible executives

categories.description: Analyzing current relationships with government bodies and entities.
categories.name: Monitor relationships

categories.description: Garnering internal advice from an informal group in order to successfully maintain and advance relationships.
categories.name: Receive input from internal advisors

categories.description: Garnering third party advice from an informal group in order to successfully maintain and advance relationships.
categories.name: Receive input from external advisors

categories.description: Meeting with government heads and representatives.
categories.name: Liaise with authorities

categories.description: Managing relations with quasi-governmental organizations, corporations, businesses, or any other agency that is treated by national laws and principles to be under the supervision of the government but also distinct and self-directed from the government.
categories.name: 管理准政府机构关系

categories.description: Engaging government, regulatory, or industry agencies to establish relationships. Analyze steps and requirements necessary for inclusion, if needed.
categories.name: Establish relationships with agencies

categories.description: Cooperating with auditors regarding potential or ongoing inquiries.
categories.name: Respond to audit inquiries

categories.description: Keeping a repository of documents that contain information about the network of partners, prospects and customers. Keep records up-to-date with routine reviews and modify as needed.
categories.name: Maintain documentation of contacts

categories.description: Ensuring regular interaction between business entity and quasi-government bodies in order to maintain established relationships. Collect and record meeting data for further analysis and use.
categories.name: Plan and manage meetings

categories.name_en: Manage relations with trade or industry groups
categories.description: Managing relations with organizations established and financed by businesses that operate in a specific industry. Participate in public relations actions such as lobbying and publishing, advertising, education, and political donations.
categories.name_zh: 管理贸易或行业团体关系
categories.name: 管理贸易或行业团体关系

categories.name_en: Evaluate the requirements for strategic relationships
categories.description: Determining the requirements to enter in to an agreement with trade or industry agencies. Discover what activities or processes can be conducted to provide the best mutual outcome.
categories.name: Evaluate the requirements for strategic relationships

categories.name_en: Monitor the success of the partnerships
categories.description: Analyzing current relationships with trade and industry groups. Ensure that the partnership in successful and make modifications where needed.
categories.name: Monitor the success of the partnerships

categories.description: Providing additional information or inclusion for third party trade or industry entities; or changing existing parameters to modify the current relationship. Communicate and execute changes.
categories.name: Extend or change the relationships

categories.description: Managing lobbying activities to affect government policies.
categories.name: 管理游说活动

categories.name_en: Manage relations with board of directors
categories.description: Maintaining relations with representatives of the stockholders. Establish corporate management-related policies and to make decisions on major company issues. Implement practices designed to engender communication, trust, and cooperation.
categories.name: 管理与董事会的关系

categories.description: Reporting financial results to management, and releasing results to the public. Report financial statements, including the income statement, balance sheet, and statement of cash flows.
categories.name: 报告财务结果

categories.description: Reporting audit findings to management. Practice an internal audit with criteria for confirming a problem, a description of the situation, and the root cause of the problem. Make recommendations that resolve the issue.
categories.name: 报告审计发现

categories.description: Managing legal practices to abide by the law, as well as ethical practices.
categories.name: 管理法律与道德事务

categories.description: Creating a code of ethics that communicate the organization's philosophy to employees, vendors, customers, clients, and the public.
categories.name: 制定道德政策

categories.description: Administering the system of rules, practices, and processes through which a company is directed and controlled. Balance stakeholder interests including shareholders, management, customers, suppliers, financiers, government, and the community. Outline a strategy for achieving organizational goals, from action plans and internal controls to performance measurement and corporate disclosure.
categories.name: 管理公司治理政策

categories.name_en: Develop and perform preventive law programs
categories.description: Creating and applying programs and activities. Encourage the adherence preventive laws, such as environmental law, sex discrimination, computer law, estate planning, corporate compliance, business planning, and property transactions.
categories.name_zh: 制定并执行预防性法律计划
categories.name: 制定并执行预防性法律计划

categories.description: Ensuring the organization's compliance position. Validate compliance with different statutes, regulatory directions, and legal principles (using Establish compliance framework and policies [17468]). Coordinate with compliance and risk management personnel.
categories.name: 确保合规

categories.description: Employing an internal system or process to identify and reduce the risk of breaching the Competition and Consumer Act 2010. Remedy any breach. Create a culture of compliance. Design compliance programs.
categories.name: Plan and initiate compliance program

categories.description: Implementing the established compliance program in order to meet the government laws and regulations. Create a compliance team that scrutinizes the rules set out by government bodies such as the Securities and Exchange Commission.
categories.name: Execute compliance program

categories.description: Managing professionals, sought externally for assistance over legal and ethical concerns. Administer and oversee assistance from subject matter experts and professionals for sourcing expert opinion and counseling over legal and ethical matters.
categories.name: 管理外部律师

categories.name_en: Assess problem and determine work requirements
categories.description: Examining the problems and deciding the action requirements for engaging outside counsel. This process element calls upon the organization to internally analyze the issues for which assistance from external counsel is needed. Additionally, the organization needs to break-down the issue, identifying the tasks and exercises where outside counsel can help.
categories.name: Assess problem and determine work requirements

categories.description: Recruiting the assistance of outside counsel for any legal and/or ethical concerns. Engage and/or retain any external counsel sought from subject matter experts and professionals.
categories.name: Engage/Retain outside counsel if necessary

categories.description: Making a financial plan. This strategy sets out, using figures, an organization's expected future results. Enlist the finance function to support work generated by other business functions in order to build and secure their support for the budget.
categories.name: Receive strategy/budget

categories.name_en: Receive work product and manage/monitor case and work performed
categories.description: Receiving deliverables from outside counsel, and monitoring the efforts committed by them. Track the progress of, collect, and validate the required work product from the subject matter experts and professionals engaged as external counsel. Verify the amount of effort dedicated by these counsels to the issue at hand, in order to confirm their fees.
categories.name: Receive work product and manage/monitor case and work performed

categories.description: Making payments to legal advisers for their services. Payments include addressing issues or suits by customers, suppliers, competitors, bankers, government agencies, etc.
categories.name: Process payment for legal services

categories.description: Keeping track of the legal activities and performance of the organization.
categories.name: Track legal activity/performance

categories.description: Safeguarding the intellectual property of the organization. This process requires the organization to protect a wide variety of intellectual property created by it. This includes leveraging artificial intelligence(AI) to identify potential infringement of intellectual property and making sure employees are adhering to company policies around use of artificial intelligence(AI). It involves creating and managing non-disclosure agreements (NDAs), following up on current developments in the areas where the organization holds patents, tracking the use of the organization's copyrighted material, creating and upholding licensing terms, and administering policies for safeguarding intellectual property.
categories.name: 保护知识产权

categories.description: Managing the patents and copyrights already held or sought by the organization. Administer and oversee applying for, securing, and maintaining intellectual property rights in the form of patents and copyrights. Submit applications for such rights. Handle associated legal issues. Draft and communicate proper attributions. Collect royalties. Monitor any misuse of the intellectual property rights.
categories.name: Manage copyrights, patents, and trademarks

categories.name_en: Maintain intellectual property rights and restrictions
categories.description: Managing the upkeep of intellectual property rights by creating and managing a framework of rules, policies, procedures, and restrictions. Outline a clear policy for any possible scenario of their use by any external agent.
categories.name: Maintain intellectual property rights and restrictions

categories.description: Administering and overseeing the terms and policies associated with licensing the organization's intellectual property. Create and manage the policies and terms governing the possible granting of a license to any external agent. Demarcate a clear framework that governs the licensing of any patents or copyrights held by the organization.
categories.name: Administer licensing terms

categories.description: Managing options regarding licensing agreements. Follow favorable terms and conditions.
categories.name: Administer options

categories.description: Resolving disputes or civil lawsuits internally or externally.
categories.name: 解决争议与诉讼

categories.description: Providing legal advice concerning the substance or procedure of a law in relation to a particular situation.
categories.name: 提供法律咨询/顾问

categories.description: Negotiating terms to reach a final draft of a contract that is acceptable to all parties.
categories.name: 谈判并起草合同协议

categories.description: Managing a public relations programs through business and communications skills.
categories.name: 管理公共关系计划

categories.description: Developing and administering community relations. Establish business connections with the people constituting the environment the organization operates in and draws resources from in order to foster mutual understanding, trust, and support. Create programs that promote the organization's image in a positive and community-oriented way.
categories.name: 管理社区关系

categories.description: Developing and managing relations with media. Develop connections with journalists to solicit critical, third-party endorsements for a product, issue, service, or organization.
categories.name: 管理媒体关系

categories.description: Promoting political security and stability in the regions where the organization conducts business. Encourage political stability in the regions where the organization operates. Support civic programs, citizen engagement, connection platforms, etc.
categories.name: 促进政治稳定

categories.description: Developing press releases to communicate developments and generate interest in the organization.
categories.name: 撰写新闻稿

categories.description: Issuing press releases to carefully selected media in distribution channels such as the web, newspapers, and social media.
categories.name: 发布新闻稿

categories.description: Performing activities by an organization that are fundamental to the successful operation of the organization, even across functions in a business. Capabilities defined in the PCF include business process management; portfolio, program, and project management; quality management; change management; benchmarking; environmental health and safety management; and knowledge management.
categories.name: 开发和管理业务能力

categories.description: Establishing and administering governance for management of the processes. Outline and manage the frameworks for management of the processes. Define the business processes. Administer the performance of the processes. Enhance the business processes.
categories.name: 管理业务流程

categories.name_en: Establish and maintain process management governance
categories.description: Defining and managing the organization's approach to governing business process management. Establish and manage tools to support the governance process. Assign ownership for all business processes. Perform activities to administer the governing process.
categories.name_zh: 建立和维护流程管理治理
categories.name: 建立和维护流程管理治理

categories.description: Outlining and managing the methodology for administering business process management (BPM). Define the method for setting standards and priorities for BPM efforts. Identify BPM governance leaders. Define BPM project participants' roles.
categories.name: Define and manage governance approach

categories.name_en: Establish and maintain process tools and templates
categories.description: Instituting, organizing, and maintaining the upkeep of the techniques used for business process management (BPM). Create and maintain templates of BPM tools that can be readily implemented, including process engine, business analytics, content management, and collaboration tools.
categories.name: Establish and maintain process tools and templates

categories.description: Assigning resources (employees) ownership of tasks. These include the responsibility of identifying, analyzing, and improving business processes in order to meet the goals and objectives such as increasing profits and performance, reducing costs, and accelerating schedules.
categories.name: Assign and support process ownership

categories.description: Implementing and executing activities for governing business processes. Execute activities that encourage participation, accountability, transparency, responsiveness, equity and inclusiveness, etc. within the business processes.
categories.name: Perform process governance activities

categories.description: Determining and organizing the structural composition of business processes. Design, establish, and administer the framework. Identify any cross-functional processes that are mandatory for achieving business excellence.
categories.name: 定义和管理流程框架

categories.description: Defining and managing the framework that outlines the required business processes of the organization, key elements, and how they should interact. Institute strategy infrastructure and product, operations, and enterprise management.
categories.name: Establish and maintain process framework

categories.description: Recognizing the different functional areas working on the same project or goal.
categories.name: Identify cross-functional processes

categories.description: Outlining and establishing the business processes of the organization. Scope, analyze, map, and publish processes for the employees who may require it.
categories.name: 定义流程

categories.description: Defining the extent and limits of business processes. Define the range and diversity of all the set of activities and tasks that, once completed, will accomplish an organizational goal.
categories.name: Scope processes

categories.description: Assessing and examining the set of activities and tasks that, once completed, will accomplish an organizational goal. Create a business process model that captures how a business process works and how individuals from different groups work together to achieve a business goal.
categories.name: Analyze processes

categories.description: Realizing those practices and procedures that are the most effective to the success of the business and making that information available.
categories.name: Identify published best practices

categories.name_en: Identify and denote process control points
categories.description: Establishment of a "checkpoint" in a process that prevent the process from continuing unless all requirements are satisfied.
categories.name: Identify and denote process control points

categories.description: Defining what a business entity does, who is responsible, to what standard a business process should be completed, and how the success of a business process can be determined. Identify processes, gather information gathering, interview participants, map processes, and perform analysis.
categories.name: Model and document processes

categories.description: Disclosing the information available on business processes. Ensure the availability of the information regarding the business processes to all process team members, business stakeholders, and process owners. Use BPM software, as well as business process diagrams and documents that help depict the required information.
categories.name: Publish processes

categories.description: Evaluating and handling the performance of business processes. Provide training to process owners. Support the execution of business processes. Measure and report the performance of the business processes.
categories.name: 管理流程绩效

categories.description: Providing training for the employees and process owners that administer the business processes. Design internal training programs or source third party agencies to provide the skills and training necessary.
categories.name: Provide process training

categories.description: Assisting and executing the business processes. Use business process execution language (BEPL), which is a standard, executable language for specifying actions within the business processes with the use of web services.
categories.name: Support process execution

categories.description: Defining and using performance indicators to consider the financial perspective, customer perspective, internal process perspective, and learning perspective of the organization.
categories.name: Measure and report process performance

categories.description: Determining the need for additional performance indicators that would be necessary to successfully achieve the business goal.
categories.name: Identify additional metrics as required

categories.description: Identifying, selecting, and managing improvements. Based on the type and scope of the improvement, determination of the appropriate improvement methodology (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, etc.) should guide the effort. This includes continuous improvement, process redesign, process reengineering, and application of the organizations approaches for Manage projects.
categories.name: 改进流程

categories.description: Helping a process owner to identify, analyze, and improve existing business processes within an organization to meet new goals and objectives.
categories.name: Identify and select improvement opportunities

categories.description: Assessing and choosing methodologies to identify, analyze, and improve existing processes within an organization to meet new goals and objective. Assess the various methodologies available such as process mapping, statistical process control, and simulation. Choose the most appropriate and effective methodology.
categories.name: Select process improvement methodology

categories.description: Developing and implementing a systematic approach to help the organization optimize its underlying processes in order to achieve more efficient results. Systematically gather information to clarify issues or problems. Intervene for improvements. Restructure training programs as appropriate to increase effectiveness.
categories.name: Manage improvement projects

categories.description: Persistently implementing activities for improving business processes.
categories.name: Perform continuous improvement activities

categories.description: Managing investments, holdings, products, businesses, and brands, along with the related projects that together constitute a program.
categories.name_zh: 管理组合、项目群与项目
categories.name: 管理组合、项目群与项目

categories.description: Managing the business portfolio of the organization, including investments, holdings, products, businesses, and brands. Establish a portfolio strategy. Define portfolio governance. Monitor and control the portfolio.
categories.name: 管理组合

categories.description: Instituting the strategy for managing business portfolio. Create a systematic plan that defines the strategy for managing investments, holdings, products, businesses, and brands.
categories.name: Establish portfolio strategy

categories.description: Outlining the administration of business portfolio of the organization. Create and manage the rules and regulations regarding the business processes in order to identify, select, prioritize, and monitor portfolio components. Include a set of metrics to indicate the health and progress of the portfolio in the most vital area.
categories.name: Define portfolio governance

categories.description: Overseeing and administering the business portfolio of the organization. Monitor all activities related to investments, holdings, products, businesses, and brands by effectively monitoring and supervising these activities.
categories.name: Monitor and control portfolio

categories.description: Establishing, implementing, and managing business programs. Successfully handle related projects that together constitute a program. Establish the program structure and approach. Coordinate with stakeholders and partners. Execute the program. Assess and report the performance of the program. Coordinate and prioritize resources across projects. Manage links between the projects and the overall costs and risks of the program.
categories.name: 管理项目群

categories.description: Constructing and instituting the framework and approach to manage business programs. Monitor key factors such as governance, alignment with the overall business vision, assurance, and management.
categories.name: Establish program structure and approach

categories.description: Managing relationships with stakeholders and partners of the business programs.
categories.name: Manage program stakeholders and partners

categories.description: Administering and implementing business programs. Implement and execute programs with the intention of improving an organization's performance. Execute all the individual projects of the program to ensure the desired success.
categories.name: Manage program execution

categories.description: Evaluating and documenting the performance of business programs. Evaluate the performance of the programs. Create reports on the basis of the analysis. Use performance indicators and metrics such as desired/achieved goals, completion dates, issues and defects, and cost effectiveness.
categories.name: Review and report program performance

categories.description: Establishing the scope of the projects. Create plans for implementing the projects. Initiate projects. Review and report project performance to management. Close projects.
categories.name: 管理项目

categories.description: Establishing the horizons of business projects. Identify the objectives of the program, along with the resource requirements.
