Track the utility of the workforce deployed. Examine the interactions between the customer and customer service representatives to achieve high quality.
categories.change_details: RENAME, WAS: Plan and manage customer service work force, c10391, c10392
categories.name_zh: 计划和管理客户服务人力
categories.name: 计划和管理客户服务人力

categories.name_en: Forecast volume of customer service contacts
categories.description: Projecting the total workforce required to service customer service inquiries in order to effectively predict the volume of vendor contracts required. Estimate the number of the customer service contracts in an agreed-upon time frame in order to strategically maintain the workforce necessitated for customer inquires. Analyze historical data around customer service contracts, the universe of customer inquiries, frequency of inquiries, servicing capability (per head) of the employees, etc.
categories.name: Forecast volume of customer service contacts

categories.description: Deploying the workforce to manage customer service contracts. Create a systematic summary of the operations and service required, as well as the specific amount of workforce that is to be deployed to the customer service operations. Ensure workforce is directly proportional to the estimated forecast of customer service contracts.
categories.change_details: RENAME, WAS: Schedule customer service work force
categories.name: Schedule customer service workforce

categories.description: Tracking the utilization of workforce deployed for managing customer service operations. Monitor the utility of the workforce deployed for managing customer service operations in order to evaluate its efficiency and cost effectiveness. Calculate the overall labor effectiveness, which measures the utility, performance, and quality of the workforce.
categories.change_details: RENAME, WAS: Track work force utilization
categories.name: Track workforce utilization

categories.name_en: Monitor and evaluate quality of customer interactions with customer service representatives
categories.description: Tracking and determining the quality of interactions between the customer and customer representatives. Use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI), to record and effectively assess customer representatives' interactions.
categories.name: Monitor and evaluate quality of customer interactions with customer service representatives

categories.name_en: Manage customer service problems, requests, and inquiries
categories.description: Handling the requests and inquiries from customers that seek information regarding the organization's products/services. Obtain the customer requests online and by phone. Direct these requests to higher-level representatives. Approve requests, and respond to customers.
categories.name_zh: 管理客户问题、请求与查询
categories.name: 管理客户问题、请求与查询

categories.name_en: Receive customer problems, requests, and inquiries
categories.description: Receiving requests for information from customers over multiple channels. Receive various requests and inquiries from customers regarding products/services. Accept these inquiries through channels such as email, telephone, online forms, text messages, social media, and in person. Supply dedicated equipment, systems, and personnel.
categories.name: Receive customer problems, requests, and inquiries

categories.description: Analyzing various requests and inquiries from customers regarding products/services. Provide answers and offerings to satisfy the customer's needs.
categories.name: Analyze problems, requests, and inquiries

categories.name_en: Resolve customer problems, requests, and inquiries
categories.description: Routing customer inquiries in order to service them with the most apposite response. Direct customer inquires to the best suited personnel or system. Have a system or procedure capable of efficiently channeling these requests.
categories.name: Resolve customer problems, requests, and inquiries

categories.name_en: Respond to customer problems, requests, and inquiries
categories.description: Responding to customer requests by email, conversation, interactive voice response, mail, etc. with the most appropriate reply. Instill a robust process to locate the right information for a solution to a customer's problem.
categories.name: Respond to customer problems, requests, and inquiries

categories.description: Utilizing customer inquiries as opportunities to either provide a comparable service to the one in question, offer additional complimentary service, or suggest a service that is better than what was initially offered.
categories.name: Identify and capture upsell/cross-sell opportunities

categories.description: Providing possible sales leads to the sales team in an effort to garner more business opportunities.
categories.name: Deliver opportunity to sales team

categories.description: Obtaining customer complaints online or by phone. Direct these complaints to higher-level representatives as appropriate. Resolve them. Respond to customers.
categories.name: 管理客户投诉

categories.description: Receiving any complaints or grievances from customers for the organization's products/services. Receive objections, complaints, and criticism from customers regarding products/services through email, telephone, online forms, text messages, social media, in person, etc. Dedicate equipment, systems, and personnel.
categories.name: Receive customer complaints

categories.description: Routing any complaints or grievances received from customers in order to address them in the most appropriate manner. Direct complaints to the best suited personnel or system. Implement a system or procedure capable of efficiently channeling the various objections, complaints, and criticism from customers over the offerings provided by the organization.
categories.name: Route customer complaints

categories.description: Resolving any customer complaints that are deemed to be sound and reasonable. Redress any objections, grievances, and complaints received from customers regarding the offerings provided by the organization. Identify the legitimate complaints, where the situation needs to be appropriately corrected. Deploy personnel who can rectify the issue within a stipulated time frame.
categories.name: Resolve customer complaints

categories.description: Responding to customer complaints including all activities necessitated to service any objections, complaints, or grievances with the most appropriate reply. Source the right information to formulate a response that eases the discomfort being experienced by the customer. (Closely coordinate with Resolve customer complaints [10399].)
categories.name: Respond to customer complaints

categories.description: Analyzing complaint logs to provide input for continuous service improvement and customer profiling.
categories.name: Analyze customer complaints and response/redressal

categories.description: Acquiring returns and identify if the returns are scraped or salvaged.
categories.name: 处理退货

categories.description: Approving and carrying forward the requests by the customers to return the product. This is part of the process of returning a product in order to receive a refund, replacement, or repair during the product's warranty period.
categories.name: Authorize return

categories.description: Notating the reason for the return of the product.
categories.name: Process return and record reason

categories.name_en: Report incidents and risks to regulatory bodies
categories.description: Notifying all stakeholders, legal, and industry regulatory bodies of the incidents and risks related to a return or recall, if needed.
categories.change_details: RENAME, WAS: Report Incidents, Adverse Events and Corrective Action Preventive Action (CAPA), -12841, -12842, -12843, -12844, -12845, -17705
categories.name_zh: 向监管机构报告事件与风险
categories.name: 向监管机构报告事件与风险

categories.description: Assigning post-sales policies and paying claims on purchased products. This is a process that is an administrative function focused on creating rules (claim codes). This group ensures that claims are valid and are processed quickly.  As well as to quickly determine responsibility for claim settlement.
categories.name: 产品售后服务

categories.description: Filing product registrations.
categories.name: 产品注册

categories.description: Identifying, investigating, and processes warranty claims. This process includes: receipt and validation of a warranty claim; definition and diagnosis /root cause analysis of an issue and recommendation for corrective action; the determination of responsibility for settlement of the claim; the transaction being approved or denied; and the originator being notified and payment authorized. In the case of a recurring event, further investigation (definition and diagnosis or root cause analysis) is performed, and a recommendation for corrective action is made and implemented in production/design. It ends when the claim is closed.
categories.name: 处理保修索赔

categories.description: Receiving incoming warranty claims. Route claim to correct department. Document claim.
categories.name: Receive warranty claim

categories.description: Ensuring that the claim falls within the parameters of the warranty in question. After validation is made, the claim must be investigated.
categories.name: Validate warranty claim

categories.description: Executing investigational and analysis of warranty claims. This involves notification and definition of a warranty issue, includes the scheduling of a field service agent to perform further investigation; the request and receipt of defective parts; and diagnosis/root cause analysis. This concludes with the receipt of the result and recommendation for corrective action.
categories.name: Investigate warranty issues

categories.description: Defining the issue of the claim. The warranty team will look into the issue and understand whether it is covered by the claim code or if more detail is required. Field service will be scheduled to further qualify the definition of the issue and to collect more evidence.
categories.name: Define issue

categories.description: Scheduling additional investigative field service. This is performed for high priority claims or claims that require additional investigation. Field service engineers will gather additional information, perform further investigation, and qualify the definition of the issue.
categories.name: Schedule field service

categories.description: Requesting receipt of a defective part for further investigation.
categories.name: Request and receive defective part

categories.description: Investigating claims by an appropriate functional representative. Once the issue has been clearly defined and diagnosed and a recommendation for corrective action is determined, it will be provided to the warranty management team.
categories.name: Investigate issue/perform root cause analysis

categories.name_en: Receive investigation result/recommendation for corrective action
categories.description: Receiving investigative results to assess claim approval or denial. The warranty team will assess the results of the investigation and the recommendations for corrective action.
categories.name: Receive investigation result/recommendation for corrective action

categories.description: Identifying responsible party for a claim. There is no negotiation with the supplier at this point. There can be multiple warranties applicable to the same part: a new part warranty, a new product warranty (for the product the part is installed on), and a supplier warranty from the company that last repaired the part. The information required for this decision would be the output of Receive component/part and analyze fault [19728]."
categories.name: Determine responsible party

categories.description: Authorizing claims prior to submittal.
categories.name: Manage pre-authorizations

categories.description: Following Defining issue [20098], an approval or rejection with be made against the warranty claim. If it is deemed that the claim falls within the warranty parameters, the claim will be approved. If the claim is deemed to fall outside warranty parameters, the claim with be rejected.
categories.name: Approve or reject warranty claim

categories.description: Contacting the originator of whether the warranty claim has been approved or rejected.
categories.name: Notify originator of approve/reject decision

categories.description: Allowing for a payment to be made to the claimant.
categories.name: Authorize payment

categories.description: Archiving and closing the warranty claim after a final decision has been made to either approve or reject.
categories.name: Close claim

categories.description: Assuring that the warranty transaction has been completed.
categories.name: Reconcile warranty transaction disposition

categories.description: Managing the recovery of costs from suppliers for individual claims.
categories.name: 管理供应商追偿

categories.description: Raising a supplier recovery claim. This is based off the decision made in Receive investigation result/recommendation for corrective action [20100].
categories.name: Create supplier recovery claims

categories.description: Arranging the returns of recalled products to suppliers.
categories.name: Negotiate recoveries with suppliers

categories.description: Validating specific service requirements for individual customers. Determine and schedule resource to fulfill these requirements. Provide service to specific individual customers. Ensure the quality of service delivery.
categories.name: 产品维护服务

categories.name_en: Confirm specific service requirements for individual customer
categories.description: Acquiring or soliciting information about specific service requirements for individual customers through the customer service function. Obtain information about customer specific requests, process these requests, and create customer profiles to generate a service order.
categories.name: Confirm specific service requirements for individual customer

categories.description: Soliciting or acquiring information using various sources such as databases, customer interactions, and customer request forms. Hand them further up the hierarchy to deal with them. Categorize the user's request, determining if the request is supportable and prioritizing the request.
categories.name: Process customer request

categories.description: Documenting the individual customer service requirements solicited, along with personal information of the customers, in order to generate customized profiles that hasten the delivery process.
categories.name: Create customer profile

categories.description: Designing a short-term agreement between the service provider and customer. One-time services are ordered by the service recipient and resource-related billing is performed upon completion. Use the service order to document service and customer service work.
categories.name: Generate service order

categories.name_en: Identify and schedule resources to meet service requirements
categories.description: Determining and scheduling the resources required to fulfill customer service requirements. Create a detailed schedule about the service orders and development of these service orders.
categories.name: Identify and schedule resources to meet service requirements

categories.description: Developing a plan for sourcing and deploying the resources required to fulfill customer service needs. Document a detailed summary of all types of resources (equipment, finance, personnel, time, etc.) required to complete customer service requests and procure these resources. Identify and assess various sources in order to effectively create a resourcing plan.
categories.name: Create resourcing plan and schedule

categories.description: Designing a detailed summary of customer service order requirements, along with information concerning the timing and duration for these services. Categorize the customer needs. Monitor the services delivered.
categories.name: Create service order fulfillment schedule

categories.description: Dispatching resources for managing and fulfilling daily service requirements. Manage the progress of order fulfillment. Complete order blocks.
categories.name: Provide service to specific customers

categories.name_en: Organize daily service order fulfillment schedule
categories.description: Laying out a daily plan of specific service orders that need to be fulfilled. Document and systematically order these activities to ensure high effectiveness and efficiency.
categories.name: Organize daily service order fulfillment schedule

categories.description: Dispatching and delivering the resources needed for the specific service requirements from the source/warehouse. Manage the dispatch, transportation, and delivery of the services.
categories.name: Execute product repair

categories.description: Handling and managing orders fulfilled, along with the orders are not or partially fulfilled to track the order fulfillment progress. Use electronic devices such as trackers and GPS in order track and ensure delivery of the orders.
categories.name: Manage service order fulfillment

categories.description: Guaranteeing the quality of service provided to customers. Identify the successful and unsuccessful orders along with the service failures. Collect customer feedback. Process the feedback to ensure the quality of service in the future.
categories.name: Ensure quality of service

categories.name_en: Identify completed service orders for feedback
categories.description: Determining the service orders that have been successfully delivered. Identify the service orders completed and delivered to the customer. Leverage communication systems to ensure coordination with the customers in order to avoid mishaps.
categories.name: Identify completed service orders for feedback

categories.name_en: Identify incomplete service orders and service failures
categories.description: Determining orders which have not been completed or delivered. Identify the service orders that are partially or entirely incomplete, as well as the orders that have not been delivered to the customer. Use techniques such as project trackers to recognize the progress of the service orders.
categories.name: Identify incomplete service orders and service failures

categories.name_en: Solicit customer feedback on services delivered
categories.description: Obtaining and procuring customer reviews or feedback on the services delivered. Design a customer feedback form, or communicate with the customer through the phone or online.
categories.name: Solicit customer feedback on services delivered

categories.name_en: Process customer feedback on services delivered
categories.description: Assessing and incorporating customer reviews/feedback into the service plan to ensure high quality of service.
categories.name: Process customer feedback on services delivered

categories.name_en: Manage product recalls and regulatory audits
categories.description: Removing defective products from the distribution chain. Participate in audits from watchdog agencies.
categories.name_zh: 管理产品召回与监管审计
categories.name: 管理产品召回与监管审计

categories.description: Commencing the removal process of defective products.
categories.name: 启动召回

categories.name_en: Assess the likelihood and consequences of occurrence of any hazards
categories.description: Performing risk analysis. Identify all dangers, evaluate how probable they are, and what kinds of negative results or adverse side effect they carry.
categories.name_zh: 评估危害发生的可能性与后果
categories.name: 评估危害发生的可能性与后果

categories.description: Handling communications that are related to product recalls.
categories.name: 管理召回相关沟通

categories.description: Creating and delivering reports to regulatory agencies to provide details about handling product recalls.
categories.name: 提交监管报告

categories.description: Analyzing the effectiveness of product recalls.
categories.name_zh: 监控和审计召回有效性
categories.name: 监控和审计召回有效性

categories.description: Ending product recalls, communicating to the public and filing reports.
categories.name: 管理召回终止

categories.name_en: Evaluate customer service operations and customer satisfaction
categories.description: Calculating and assessing the operational activities of the customer service function. Evaluation is achieved through the customer requests/inquiries handling process, the customer complaint handling process, and product and services quality. Examine activities to ensure high levels of customer service.
categories.name_zh: 评估客户服务运营与客户满意度
categories.name: 评估客户服务运营与客户满意度

categories.name_en: Measure customer satisfaction with customer problems, requests, and inquiries handling
categories.description: Calculating satisfaction levels of customers by effectively evaluating the process of handling requests/inquiries of customers. Effectively calculate the performance of customer-requests/inquiries handling and resolution. Obtain information regarding requests/inquiries handling and resolution through customer feedback. Use it to explore new ideas and opportunities for enhanced customer requests/inquiries handling and resolution process.
categories.name_zh: 衡量客户对问题/请求/查询处理的满意度
categories.name: 衡量客户对问题/请求/查询处理的满意度

categories.name_en: Solicit customer feedback on customer service experience
categories.description: Creating an avenue for which the customer can provide feedback on their experience with how their inquiry, problem, or request was handled.
categories.name: Solicit customer feedback on customer service experience

categories.name_en: Analyze customer service data and identify improvement opportunities
categories.description: Reviewing customer service feedback to identify areas in which improvements can be made. Engage with management to discuss issues.
categories.name: Analyze customer service data and identify improvement opportunities

categories.name_en: Provide customer feedback to product management on customer service experience
categories.description: Handing over data to management to analyze common issues in regards to customer service.
categories.name: Provide customer feedback to product management on customer service experience

categories.name_en: Measure customer satisfaction with customer- complaint handling and resolution
categories.description: Measuring the satisfaction level of customers as pertains to how their complaints are handled and resolved. This process element requires the organization to estimate the customers level of fulfillment with the process reconciling their complaints and towards the objective of ensuring customer retention. The feedback received can be used to develop concepts for new opportunities to boost the level of customer satisfaction.
categories.name_zh: 衡量客户对投诉处理与解决的满意度
categories.name: 衡量客户对投诉处理与解决的满意度

categories.name_en: Solicit customer feedback on complaint handling and resolution
categories.description: Requesting customer feedback on the process of handling and resolving customer complaints. Obtain information about the effectiveness and performance of the customer complaint handling process from the customers through various means (e.g., online and by phone).
categories.name: Solicit customer feedback on complaint handling and resolution

categories.name_en: Analyze customer complaint data and identify improvement opportunities
categories.description: Examining the information obtained through handling and resolving complaints for development/improvement opportunities. Categorize the customer complaints data on the basis of speed, accuracy, courtesy, price, product choice, availability, hours, location, etc. Determine complaint patterns in order to diagnose areas needing enhancement.
categories.name: Analyze customer complaint data and identify improvement opportunities

categories.description: Determining complaint patterns in order to identify common issues. Document common problems for correction.
categories.name: Identify common customer complaints

categories.name_en: Measure customer satisfaction with products and services
categories.description: Calculating satisfaction levels of customers with products/services. Obtain customer feedback on products/services, as well as the effectiveness of the advertising campaigns. Examine this information to reach meaningful conclusions, which could then be used to enhance the customer service operations.
categories.name_zh: 衡量客户对产品与服务的满意度
categories.name: 衡量客户对产品与服务的满意度

categories.name_en: Gather and solicit post-sale customer feedback on products and services
categories.description: Obtaining customer feedback/review on the quality and utility derived from the products/services after the sale is complete. Use techniques such as surveys, feedback boxes, and user activity and usability tests.
categories.name: Gather and solicit post-sale customer feedback on products and services

categories.name_en: Solicit post-sale customer feedback on promotion effectiveness
categories.description: Assessing the influence of promotions on purchasing behavior. Use techniques such as surveys and product recognition tests, questionnaires or feedback flyers, and toll-free numbers in order to encourage customer interaction after the sale.
categories.change_details: RENAME, WAS: Solicit post-sale customer feedback on ad effectiveness
categories.name: Solicit post-sale customer feedback on promotion effectiveness

categories.name_en: Solicit customer feedback on cross-channel experience
categories.description: Engaging with the customer to understand their cross-channel experience. Find out what channels were effective and what areas need improvement.
categories.name: Solicit customer feedback on cross-channel experience

categories.name_en: Analyze product and service satisfaction data and identify improvement opportunities
categories.description: Assessing the information collected on customer satisfaction levels with products/services in order to determine areas for improvement. Examine the data and information extracted from the customer feedback and reviews to measure the satisfaction levels of the customers. Identify opportunities that could enhance the customer satisfaction levels and the overall customer service strategy.
categories.name: Analyze product and service satisfaction data and identify improvement opportunities

categories.name_en: Provide feedback and insights to appropriate teams (product design/development, marketing, manufacturing)
categories.description: Providing feedback from customers on products/services to the product management team. Analyze information collected through Gather and solicit post-sale customer feedback on products/services [11238]. Share with the product management team for consideration while improving existing offerings or developing new products/services.
categories.name: Provide feedback and insights to appropriate teams (product design/development, marketing, manufacturing)

categories.description: Assessing the cost and effectiveness of warranties.
categories.name: 评估和管理保修绩效

categories.name_en: Measure customer satisfaction with warranty handling and resolution
categories.description: Evaluating how satisfied customers are with how product warranties are managed and resolved.
categories.name: Measure customer satisfaction with warranty handling and resolution

categories.name_en: Monitor and report on warranty management metrics
categories.description: Comparing warranties by using applicable metrics to see how they are handled and resolved. Develop and submit reports that summarize significant conclusions.
categories.name: Monitor and report on warranty management metrics

categories.description: Determining how warranties and warranty management can be made better and more efficient.
categories.name: Identify improvement opportunities

categories.name_en: Identify opportunities to eliminate warranty waste
categories.description: Finding ways to phase out unused or seldom used warranties.
categories.name: Identify opportunities to eliminate warranty waste

categories.description: Reviewing and assessing claims that contain deliberately incorrect information or that have been submitted with the goal to deceive the system.
categories.name: Investigate fraudulent claims

categories.description: Reviewing customer service feedback to identify areas in which improvements can be made. Engage with management to discuss issues.
categories.name: 评估召回绩效

categories.description: Delivering processes traditionally defined as "human resources". Process groups include those related to developing and maintaining workforce strategy, recruiting employees, developing and counseling employees, managing employee relations, rewarding and retaining employees, redeploying and retiring employees, managing employee information, and managing employee communications.
categories.change_details: RENAME, WAS: Develop and Manage Human Capital, c20599, +21451, -17057
categories.name: 开发和管理人力资源

categories.name_en: Develop and manage human resources (HR) planning, policies, and strategies
categories.description: Creating strategies for the HR function. Create and implement strategies for managing the work force. Supervise and enhance the strategies, plans, and policies supporting the HR function. Developing models for managing competency levels of the HR of the organization.
categories.name_zh: 制定和管理人力资源规划、政策与战略
categories.name: 制定和管理人力资源规划、政策与战略

categories.description: Creating a long-term plan that strategically aligns human resources with the company's goals. The HR function's focus is to ensure the organization has the necessary talent and capabilities to achieve its objectives, sustain its competitive advantage, and reduce employee turnover.
categories.name: 制定人力资源战略

categories.description: Strategically defining the current and future needs for developing an efficient HR strategy.
categories.name: Identify strategic HR needs

categories.name_en: Define HR and business function roles and accountability
categories.description: Outlining the charge and duty of the HR function by defining its responsibility areas, as well as ensuring its accountability. Establish the HR function by laying out the roles and responsibilities for this function and the rules and regulations guiding HR. Define the goals and objectives of the HR, as well as a mission and vision for this function. Create a mechanism involving a set of policies, code of conduct, and institutional procedure to ensure HR accountability.
categories.name: Define HR and business function roles and accountability

categories.name_en: Determine HR function roles and structure
categories.description: Establishing the roles that are required to execute the HR function. This process also examines the organizational structure required to support the organization.
categories.name: Determine HR function roles and structure

categories.description: Determining how an organization's human resources department offers services to and interacts with employees.
categories.name: Determine HR delivery model

categories.description: Ascertaining the costs and expenses of the HR function. Identify and report HR investments using, for example, a cost approach or a present value of future earnings approach.
categories.name: Determine HR costs

categories.description: Evaluating the performance of HR function. Lay out the course of HR procedures that would formulate a plan of action needed to fulfill strategic HR needs. Deploy measures such as hiring policies, leave management, internal code of conducts, and compensation structure.
categories.name: Establish HR measures

categories.description: Conveying the strategies of HR function to employees and management. Effectively explain the vision, plans, and anticipated benefits of the HR strategy to employees, as well as the public. Develop statements and messages that are easy to read, informative, and relevant to the audience.
categories.name: Communicate HR strategies

categories.description: Creating a strategy for the use of systems/technologies/tools in operating the HR function. This is inclusive of all forms of new and evolving technology such as artificial intelligence (AI). Create a strategy concerning the use and utility of HR support tools and technologies. Decide what specific tools to use and in what quantity. Determine the levels of technology required for the HR management.
categories.name: Develop strategy for HR systems/technologies/tools

categories.description: Creating, maintaining and communicating company's reputation and values to keep current employees and attract potential hires.
categories.name: Manage employer branding

categories.description: Designing the intended end-to-end employee experience across key moments in the employee lifecycle to support engagement, performance, retention, and alignment with organizational culture and workforce objectives.
categories.name: Design the employee experience

categories.name_en: Develop and implement workforce planning, policies, and strategies
categories.description: Creating and executing strategies and policies for smooth administration of workforce. Determine and gather skill requirements. Plan the requirements for employee resourcing per unit. Create compensation, succession, HR program, and employee diversity plans. Develop and administer policies for HR. Develop benefits for employees. Create models for work force strategies.
categories.change_details: RENAME, WAS: Develop and implement workforce strategy and policies, c10425, c10427, c11622, c11623, +21432, +21433, +21693, -10423
categories.name_zh: 制定与实施劳动力规划、政策与战略
categories.name: 制定与实施劳动力规划、政策与战略

categories.description: Evaluating the current and future skill requirements of the organization with regard to the overall corporate strategy of the organization and market conditions. Identify and establish the minimum skills needed for the requisite HR needs.
categories.name: Perform strategic workforce planning

categories.name_en: Develop and manage strategic workforce planning framework
categories.description: Defining and maintaining the structure, principles, and approaches used to assess workforce supply and demand, capabilities, and gaps over the strategic planning horizon.
categories.name: Develop and manage strategic workforce planning framework

categories.description: Determining the requirements for employees and the need for employee resourcing for each unit/function. Lay out a plan detailing employee resourcing requirements of individual functions and the organization as a whole.
categories.change_details: RENAME, WAS: Plan employee resourcing requirements per business unit/organization
categories.name: Perform business unit workforce planning

categories.name_en: Advise business in implementing strategic workforce planning
categories.description: Providing guidance and expertise to business leaders on applying the strategic workforce planning framework to inform workforce decisions, plans, and initiatives.
categories.name: Advise business in implementing strategic workforce planning

categories.name_en: Partner with the business to execute workforce plan
categories.description: Collaborating with business leaders to translate workforce plans into actionable initiatives and to support execution of agreed workforce actions.
categories.name: Partner with the business to execute workforce plan

categories.name_en: Monitor and adjust strategic workforce plan
categories.description: Tracking workforce outcomes and changes in business needs to update workforce plans and address emerging gaps, risks, or opportunities.
categories.name: Monitor and adjust strategic workforce plan

categories.name_en: Develop total compensation and rewards strategy
categories.description: Designing a plan that specifies the combination of wages, salaries, and benefits the employees receive in exchange for work. Define the total amount of compensation, in addition to the manner in which the compensation is paid and the purposes for which employees can receive bonuses, salary increases, incentives and non-monetary rewards.
categories.change_details: RENAME, WAS: Develop compensation plan, c10210, +21644, +21645
categories.name: Develop total compensation and rewards strategy

categories.name_en: Establish wages, salaries, and benefits strategy
categories.description: Defining the strategic approach for wages, salaries, and benefits to support workforce attraction, retention, performance, and alignment with organizational objectives and market conditions.
categories.name: Establish wages, salaries, and benefits strategy

categories.description: Creating a scheme of rewards and recognition for employees to promote a results-based culture. Create specific incentives to reach desired outcomes, such as landing key clients, growing the customer base, providing exceptional servicing, and increasing profit margins.
categories.name: Establish incentive strategy

categories.description: Defining the approach to severance pay, including principles and guidelines, to support workforce transitions while managing financial, legal, and reputational considerations.
categories.name: Establish a severance pay strategy

categories.description: Creating and implementing the plan for continuation of key positions within the organization. Identify internal people with the potential to fill key business leadership positions. Provide critical development experiences to employees who can move into important roles. Engage leaders to support the development of high-potential leaders.
categories.name: Develop succession plan

categories.description: Creating a program that incorporates incentives and compensation put forth by the organization to recognize high performing workers and excellence in leadership.
categories.name: Develop high performers/leadership programs

categories.name_en: Develop diversity, equity, and inclusion plan
categories.description: Creating and implementing the plan for ensuring a diverse work force. Develop and hire employees with varying characteristics including, but not limited to, religious and political beliefs, gender, ethnicity, education, socioeconomic background, sexual orientation, and geographic location.
categories.change_details: RENAME, WAS: Develop employee diversity plan
categories.name: Develop diversity, equity, and inclusion plan

categories.name_en: Implement diversity, equity, and inclusion plan
categories.description: Execution of diversity, equity, and inclusion plans within an organization. Often called a DEI plan.
categories.name: Implement diversity, equity, and inclusion plan

categories.description: Developing a program to entice prospective resources to engage with the organization for a position of employment.
categories.name: Design talent acquisition program

categories.description: Identifying skills, knowledge, and attributes that need enhancement in order to perform a job. Develop the appropriate training programs. These programs can be computer-based, classroom, or on-the-job training, etc.
categories.name: Design talent development program

categories.description: Creating HR programs and services such as employee engagements programs to promote positive employee behavior. Create a variety of programs and services to support employees' professional and personal needs at work and at home.
categories.name: Develop other HR programs

categories.description: Creating rules and regulations that govern the HR function. Develop a policy plan that serves as a guideline for setting rules and regulations that help in achieving the HR goals and objectives.
categories.name: Develop HR policies

categories.description: Ensuring rules and regulations are followed and are flexible enough to accommodate indispensable deviations.
categories.name: Administer HR policies

categories.description: Planning benefits in kind (also called fringe benefits, perquisites, or perks). Include various types of non-wage compensations provided to employees in addition to normal wages or salaries.
categories.name: Plan employee benefits

categories.description: Creating and implementing models for effectively strategizing the work force of the organization. Develop a model that specifies the organization's overall approach for maximizing the performance of its work force by defining the goals, objectives, and expectations of the work force. Manage all aspects of performance required for the work force to function, including recruitment, selection, retention, and professional development.
categories.name: Develop workforce strategy models

categories.description: Implementing models for effectively strategizing the work force of the organization. Carry out all aspects of performance required for the work force to function, including recruitment, selection, retention, and professional development.
categories.name: Implement workforce strategy models

categories.description: Overseeing a group of similar individual or teams with similar education, skills, training, or experience.
categories.name: Manage job families

categories.description: Creating descriptions for job requisitions. Define the normal components of a job description, such as the overall position description with general areas of responsibility listed, essential functions of the job described with a couple of examples of each, required knowledge, skills, abilities, required education and experience, a description of the physical demands, and a description of the work environment.
categories.name: Develop and maintain job descriptions

categories.name_en: Monitor and update HR strategies, plans, and policies
categories.description: Supervising the HR and workforce strategy, plans, and policies in order to refurbish them whenever needed. Determine the performance of HR and workforce plans and policies by measuring the objective achievement rate and its contribution to the overall business strategy. Ensure that information about these plans and strategies is effectively communicated to various stakeholders. Incorporate any suggestions by these stakeholders when revising HR and workforce plans and policies.
categories.change_details: RENAME, WAS: Monitor and update strategy, plans, and policies, c10434, c10435, c10436
categories.name_zh: 监控与更新人力资源战略、计划和政策
categories.name: 监控与更新人力资源战略、计划和政策

categories.description: Determining the accomplishment of HR and workforce goals and objectives. Evaluate the effectiveness of the HR function by estimating the present rate of achievement of the established objectives. Use metrics to determine if the objectives are being realized. Leverage measures such as turnover, training, return on human capital, costs of labor, and expenses per employee.
categories.change_details: RENAME, WAS: Measure realization of objectives
categories.name: Measure realization of HR objectives

categories.name_en: Measure contribution of HR to business strategy
categories.description: Determining the role of the HR function in implementing the organizational strategy. Measure the correlation between the HR and workforce performance and the overall business strategy. Calculate the amount of contribution of the HR function to the overall business growth.
categories.change_details: RENAME, WAS: Measure contribution to business strategy
categories.name: Measure contribution of HR to business strategy

categories.name_en: Communicate HR plans and provide updates to stakeholders
categories.description: Conveying the plans for HR function to stakeholders. Ensure that the HR plans and strategy are effectively communicated to the people who can affect or be affected by the organization's actions, objectives, and policies such as the creditors, shareholders, employees, and suppliers. Provide regular updates to these stakeholders to ensure effective communication.
categories.change_details: RENAME, WAS: Communicate plans and provide updates to stakeholders
categories.name: Communicate HR plans and provide updates to stakeholders

categories.description: Reassessing the strategies, plans, and policies of the HR function, with the objective of revising them. Revisit the schematic plans for the HR function. Taking stock of any suggestions or feedback from the stakeholders, revamp the blueprint of HR strategies and plans.
categories.name: Review and revise HR plans

categories.description: Creating and implementing the tools for managing the competency levels of HR. Design a model for integrating HR planning with business planning. Assess current HR capacity based on the competencies against the capacity needed to achieve the vision, mission, and business goals of the organization. Consider factors such as employee development, career path, compensation policies, and performance management.
categories.name: 开发胜任力管理模型

categories.description: Determining and handling employee requirements. Recruit or source the candidates as per the requirements. Screen and select the most appropriate candidates. Take care of the newly hired and re-hired employees. Maintain records of information for all applicants.
categories.name: 招聘、寻源与甄选员工

categories.description: Handling the requirements for new employees. Create and open job requisitions by clearly defining the job descriptions. Post these requirements internally and externally, and modify them as appropriate. Manage the dates of the whole requisition process.
categories.name: 管理用人需求

categories.name_en: Align staffing plan to work force plan and business unit strategies/resource needs
categories.description: Creating a correspondence between the plan for hiring new employees and the desired employee requirements. Staff an adequate amount of people with the appropriate skills to effectively accomplish its legislative, regulatory, service, and production requirements.
categories.name: Align staffing plan to work force plan and business unit strategies/resource needs

categories.description: Developing specific job requisitions, and ensuring their accessibility. Create and open a job requisition to fill the vacant positions within the organization. Clearly describe the job title, department, fill date, and the requisite skills and qualifications for the job.
categories.name: Open job requisitions

categories.description: Reviewing and authorizing requests to fill positions to ensure alignment with workforce plans, budget constraints, and organizational approval requirements
categories.name: Approve job requisition

categories.description: Posting and advertising job descriptions. Display open job descriptions internally and externally. Use public portals, online portals, and websites to upload these requisitions in order for applications to be received.
categories.name: Post job requisitions

categories.description: Making the necessary alterations to job requisitions. Revamp or revise the job requisitions in case a position is filled or is not vacant anymore, as well as in case of any new openings. (It involves Manage the internal/external job posting websites [10449] to make the necessary changes.)
categories.name: Modify job requisitions

categories.description: Informing and communicating with the hiring manager. Notify the manager responsible for the hiring process in cases of any new position openings or changes.
categories.name: Notify hiring manager

categories.description: Determining and managing the dates for the employee requisition process.
categories.name: Manage requisition dates

categories.description: Recruiting new candidates for deployment across various functional areas inside the organization. Select methods for sourcing new employees. Manage relationships with third-party agencies. Stage recruitment fairs and drives. Manage employee referral programs.
categories.name: 招聘/寻源候选人

categories.description: Defining the methods and channels for recruitments in order to maximize the amount of candidate availability. Use channels such as headhunting, job postings, job portals, networking websites, and media advertising. Choose from the various methods of recruitment such as internal/external third-party sourcing.
categories.name: Determine recruitment methods and channels

categories.description: Organizing and executing recruiting activities and events. Activities and events include on-campus hiring, refresher courses, information sessions, career fairs, etc. to increase the coverage of the sourcing in order to ensure that the most deserving and appropriate candidates are hired.
categories.name: Perform recruiting activities/events

categories.description: Cultivating relationships with potential job candidates even when there are no immediate openings. Building the talent pipeline for potential future hiring needs.
categories.name: Develop and maintain candidate pool

categories.description: Establishing and maintaining relationships with recruitment vendors (suppliers). Create and maintain relationships with third-party agencies such as staffing and firms to expand. Use these relationships to implement the sourcing process effectively.
categories.name: Manage recruitment vendors

categories.description: Creating and managing a recruiting strategy where current employees are rewarded for referring qualified candidates for employment.
categories.name: Manage employee referral programs

categories.description: Establishing and maintaining internal and external channels for recruiting. Extract the best out of every recruitment channel. Manage all the processes related to all the sourcing channels including maintaining career pages on the organization website.
categories.name: Manage recruitment channels

categories.description: Evaluating and selecting potential employees through interviews, tests, etc.
categories.name: 筛选与甄选候选人

categories.name_en: Identify and deploy candidate selection tools
categories.description: Identifying and implementing tools for the selection of candidates. Recognize candidate selection tools such as screening, telephone interviews, hiring manager interviews, drug testing, and skills assessment. Effectively deploy these tools to check if the candidates fit in the workplace or not, as well as to ensure workplace safety.
categories.name: Identify and deploy candidate selection tools

categories.description: Assessing the candidates by their performance in the interviews. Conduct HR interview, technical interview, hiring manager interview, etc. Understand the mindset of the candidate, and comprehend his/her personal and professional lives.
categories.name: Interview candidates

categories.description: Examining the candidates through tests. Prepare tools such as aptitude, technical, and grammar tests. Test the skills of the candidate through a written, oral, or computerized test.
categories.name: Test candidates

categories.description: Approving the deserving candidates, and rejecting the others. Examining the performance of candidates. Ensure candidates would fit well with the organization. (Assess performance from Interview candidates [10457] and Test candidates [10458].)
categories.name: Select and reject candidates

categories.description: Creating and making job offers to the selected candidates. Fairly negotiate the job offers. Agree on terms with the candidate to complete the hiring process.
categories.name: 管理新入职/再入职

categories.description: Compiling job-related information for the selected candidates in order to make up a job. Include information about the job description, reporting relationship, salary, bonus potential, benefits, and vacation allotment.
categories.name: Draw up and make offer

categories.description: Negotiating an offer with selected candidates. Discuss the job offer with the candidate to ensure a mutual understanding.
categories.name: Negotiate offer

categories.description: Wrapping up the process for hiring candidates. Agree to all hiring terms and conditions. Have the candidate accept and sign the job offer.
categories.name: Hire candidate

categories.description: Creating and maintaining a system for managing the information of applicants. Create records for all candidates who apply. Maintain and track information through the use applicant-tracking systems.
categories.name: 管理应聘者信息

categories.description: Conducting a background investigation on the candidates with the objective of gathering and compiling criminal, commercial, medical, and financial information.
categories.name: Obtain candidate background information

categories.description: Creating and documenting the records of all applicants. Manage all individual applicants, including hires and non-hires. Maintain records to avoid any duplication and promote efficiency.
categories.name: Create applicant record

categories.description: Keeping track of all the information about the candidates who apply for jobs. Use applicant-tracking systems that can be accessed online as a central location and database for recruitment efforts.
categories.name: Manage/Track applicant data

categories.name_en: Complete position classification and level of experience
categories.description: Identifying the requirements for the position to be filled. Determine the experience and skills necessary to perform the tasks outlined.
categories.name: Complete position classification and level of experience

categories.name_en: Archive and retain records of non-hires
categories.description: Retaining and storing the records of the candidates who were rejected and not hired to ensure future availability in case the need arises. Create a centralized repository of profiles. Label these records in order to readily identify them. Add remarks for any future consideration.
categories.name: Archive and retain records of non-hires

categories.name_en: Manage employee onboarding, training, and development
categories.description: Assisting employees in developing their capabilities, and providing them counseling services. Handle the orientation and deployment of the employees.
